How to Save a World is a worker-placement game with hand-building and resource management. Each turn, you assign workers to perform critical tasks or spend action cards to help advance your goals. At the end of each round, the projects will be assessed and the asteroid will move ever closer. Can you make the right decisions to avert disaster in this competitive science-fiction game?

—description from publisher

expansions.name: How to Save a World: Tanaconda Promo Card

406291.name: 스플렌더: Pokémon (Splendor: Pokémon)
406291.description:
스플렌더: Pokémon plays much like the original Splendor game, but with special rules based on Pokémon.

On your turn, you may (1) collect Pokéballs (which come in five colors), or (2) catch a Pokémon, or (3) reserve a Pokémon. If you collect Pokéballs, you take either three different colors of Pokéballs or two Pokéballs of the same color (as long as four are available). If you catch a Pokémon, you pay its cost in Pokéballs, then add it to your playing area. If you reserve a Pokémon — in order to make sure you get it, or, why not, your opponents don't get it — you place it in front of you face down for later catching; this costs you a round, but you also get a Master Ball which you can later use as a Pokéball of any color. Each Pokémon you have caught gives you a permanent Pokéball that you can use toward catching all future Pokémon, meaning as you catch more Pokémon, it becomes easier to catch the ones that are more expensive and worth more points.

Differences from the original Splendor include:

     At the end of your turn, you can evolve one of the Pokémon in your collection if the next level of that Pokémon is in the display and you have the required Pokéballs. More points for you, and another card in your Pokédex...
     There are two new decks of cards: Rare Pokémon and Legendary Pokémon. Only one of each is on display at a time, and they each provide 2 permanent Pokéballs instead of 1 when caught. Legendary Pokémon are worth more points than Rare Pokémon but require you to use a Master Ball in order to catch them.


When a player has 18 or more points in their collection, you complete the final round, then whoever has the most points wins.

families.name: Versions & Editions: Versions with IP after the original release

406619.name: Kronologic: Cuzco 1450
406619.description:
Kronologic are modern alternatives to Clue: find the culprit, the weapon and the location. Each turn, the active player needs to interrogate a suspect (by aligning cards under perforated cardboard tiles), giving away information to everyone at the table, but giving the active player extra information (how many times a suspect visited a specific location, at what time, etc.)

Set in the majestic city of Cuzco during the year 1450, Kronologic: Cuzco 1450 offers 15 exciting challenges spread across 3 immersive scenarios. By sharing some - but not all  - of the you gather, you race with the other players to solve 3 Inca-themed mystery scenarios.

Be the first to solve the mystery to win the game.

expansions.name: Kronologic: Cuzco 1450 – La Vallée des Offrandes

406746.name: World Wonders: Mundo Wonders Pack
406746.description:
World Wonders: Mundo Wonders Pack adds nine new wondrous monuments from the ancient world to World Wonders, along with a new gameplay mode. This mode features nine cards that add even more strategy to the scoring of new monuments, allowing for higher scores depending on the objectives.

The expansion also comes with cards to use the new wonders in the normal game mode.

406959.name: 20 Strong: Tanglewoods Promo Cards
406959.description:
Contains 3 double sided cards:

Stilts/Rump: After suffering 2 or more damage in the Suffer Damage step, you may swap the values of any two stats. Then flip Stilts. / The next time your Health would be reduced, reduce the highest of your stats by the same amount. Then, flip Rump.

Tink/Bell: Anytime you forgo a reward on an enemy, when that card would be discarded, you may put it under Tink instead. You may discard a card from under Tink and flip her to ignore the After or Special of an enemy until the end of the Engagement. / Anytime you forgo a reward on an enemy, when that card would be discarded, you may put it under Bell instead. If there are at least three cards under Bell, you may discard all cards under Bell to defeat a non-boss enemy. Then, flip Bell.

Jack/Sprig: When damage from Miss defeat an enemy, you man +1 Health. Anytime you have 5 Health or more, flip Jack. / In the Apply Dice step, you may -2 Health to change a miss to Crit, or op to two Basic Hit to Crit. Then, flip Sprig.

families.name: Folk Tales & Fairy Tales: Jack and the Beanstalk
Folk Tales & Fairy Tales: Peter Pan

408223.name: Nucleum: Australia
408223.description:
Saxony's energy revolution was so impactful that everyone wanted to start using Nucleums in their regions. Australia's huge deposits of uranium were ripe for the taking, leading to visionaries — lured by the vast number of possibilities — visiting the continent and changing it into a new global power. Here, these entrepreneurs have to face new challenges presented by the sheer size of the continent. Fortunately, the clever use of shipping lanes will help them transport resources more efficiently than by rail and even gain access to the nearby island of Tasmania, where a mad scientist conducting his own experiments managed to replicate Elsa's invention, which is now proudly presented as an experimental power plant in the island's capital of Hobart.

Nucleum: Australia comes with a new map that introduces several new concepts and rule changes to the Nucleum base game. Use shipping lanes to expand your networks, build your own coal mines, and try the expert variant with bidding for the experiments.

—description from the publisher

408591.name: Terraforming Mars: Icy Impactors Promo Card
408591.description:
Winter Season Promo 2023 of FryxGames, which you can buy on its own, or get for free if you order something at their webstore during Winter 2023.
Spend 10 M€ (titanium may be used) to add 2 asteroids here, or spend 1 asteroid here to place an ocean tile. FIRST PLAYER CHOOSES WHERE YOU MUST PLACE IT.
Promo card X47.

410201.name: Wyrmspan
410201.description:
You are an amateur dracologist in the world of Wyrmspan, a place where dragons of all shapes, sizes, and colors roam the skies. Excavate a hidden labyrinth you recently unearthed on your land and entice these beautiful creatures to roost in the sanctuary of your caves.

During a game of Wyrmspan, you will build a sanctuary for dragons of all shapes and sizes. Your sanctuary begins with 3 excavated spaces—the leftmost space in your Crimson Cavern, your Golden Grotto, and your Amethyst Abyss. Over the course of the game, you will excavate additional spaces in your sanctuary and entice dragons to live there, chaining together powerful abilities and earning the favor of the Dragon Guild.

Wyrmspan is inspired by the mechanisms of Wingspan, though its unique elements make Wyrmspan a standalone game (not compatible with Wingspan).

—description from the publisher

410264.name: Apex Legends: The Board Game – Squad 1 Expansion
410264.description:
Outside the ring, they’re champions. Inside, they’re equals. Not all fighters are heroes, and each competes for their own reasons. But the goal remains the same—survive, win, and become a Legend.

The Squad 1 Expansion introduces 6 new Legends into the roster of Apex Legends: The Board Game.


    The Toxic Trapper Caustic uses poison traps and gas grenades, creating hazard zones on the battlefield and weakening enemy Legends before closing in for the kill.
    The Surveillance Expert Crypto utilizes his surveillance drone to scout and loot the area, as well as drain the shields of his enemies with EMP attacks.
    The Holographic Trickster Mirage uses Hologram decoys to confuse his opponents, shield himself from harm, and conceal his location.
    The High-speed Daredevil Octane outsmarts other Legends with spectacular stunts and pure speed.
    The Synthetic Nightmare Revenant uses his Silence Device to prevent his foes from using their abilities, while his Death Totem serves his squadmates in cheating death.
    The Static Defender Wattson helps out allied Legends by recharging their shields and creating fortified safe zones on the battlefield.


—description from the publisher

410265.name: Apex Legends: The Board Game – Board 1 Expansion
410265.description:
Push the conflict into new ground! The Board 1 Expansion adds new Map tiles for use in Apex Legends: The Board Game, based on the industrial themes of Kings Canyon and offering new buildings and terrain features, including fences, which function as impassable obstacles. The new board can be attached to the default one using a set of connector tiles, which enlarges the potential battlefield.

The expansion also introduces a new game mode—Control Point—and a set of new pre-made Maps.

—description from the publisher

410266.name: Apex Legends: The Board Game – Solo and Co-op Expansion
410266.description:
Designed with Radek Ignatów and Dávid Turczi, the Solo and Co-op Expansion introduces the option to play Apex Legends: The Board Game in single player mode or in cooperation with another player against a squad of automated opponents.

Inside, you will find a set of components that turn each of the core six Legends into unique, automated enemies.

—description from the publisher

410267.name: Apex Legends: The Board Game – Loba Expansion
410267.description:
The Apex Games arenas are brimming with treasures just waiting to be plucked. And if you want something valuable and well guarded—Loba is who you go to.

This expansion offers a wealth of new content for Apex Legends The Board Game, adding Loba into the game’s Legend roster. Loba uses her Burglar’s Best Friend bracelet to escape from perilous situations and makes sure her squad has access to the best equipment available by deploying her Black Market Boutique directly onto the battlefield.

The expansion also grants access to the Nessie Special Feature, introducing the loveable character of Nessie into Apex Legends™: The Board Game as an interactive component, and spicing up each session through the use of Nessie Feat cards, which grant the players access to powerful and subversive gameplay effects, encouraging them to diverge from their usual strategies.

Also included are plastic miniatures for the Control Beacon and Heat Shields game modes, which replace the cardboard ones found in the Core Box.

—description from the designer

410378.name: Temple Code
410378.description:
Face rival archeologists in a race to unlock an ancient temple's forgotten secrets. Before you can lay hands on the invaluable treasure it's holding, you have to deduce the combinations of statuettes unlocking the hidden vault!

At the beginning of Temple Code, each player receives a combination card with a series of three unique statuettes that everyone can see but themselves. Each round, two combination cards are dealt face-up in front of each player. On your turn, pick a set of cards in front of another player, then take one for yourself and give them the other one. By aligning this card next to the one you're trying to guess, you will get hints about the matching statuettes: each blue circle indicates a statuette that is on both cards at the same place, and each orange triangle stands for a statuette that is on both cards, but in different positions.

At any time during the game, a player can guess the card in front of them. Whether they guessed correctly or not, they receive a new combination card to guess.

Whoever first correctly guesses two combinations wins.

—description from the publisher

411053.name: Nemesis: Retaliation – Stretch Goals
411053.description:
Nemesis: Retaliation - Stretch Goals contains all of the Gamefound Stretch Goals from the Nemesis: Retaliation crowdfunding campaign.


     New Alien Race - Neoflesh: 50+ Minis (9 Delver Shield Robots, 9 Delver Exploders, 9 Delver Ranged Shooters, 9 Melee Delvers, 10 Twitchlings, 5 Cultists, 1 Cult Queen), 20 Event cards, 20 Attack cards, 10 Queen health cards, 12 Exploration cards, 5 Cultist tokens, 5 Dead body tokens, 9 Computer tokens, 30 Intruder tokens, 1 Intruder bag help card.



     Insider mini-expansion (1 Mini/Standee, 1 Insider double-sided card, 55 Story cards).
     Bioenhancement Expert Character Packs (1 Mini and 1 Standee, 1 Character tile, 1 Plastic ring, 10 Action cards, 1 Personal item).
     Contractor module: enables characters from Nemesis and Nemesis Lockdown to be used inside Retaliation: 6 double-sided Contractor character tiles - 60 Action cards (5 for each of the 12 Contractors) - 12 Contractor Draft cards - 24 Character Item cards (2 for each of the 12 Contractors).



     1 Lucky burst die (plus explanation card)
     Space Platypus first Player Marker Mini

411239.name: Graffiti 6
411239.description: The role of the three cards lined up at the end of the game is the strongest player wins. In the case of the same hand, the number included in the hand is the biggest player wins.

411435.name: Coffee Rush: Piece of Cake
411435.description:
Welcome back! Your cafe is expanding, and drinks are no longer enough. Thankfully, you can now serve cakes to keep your customers happy. Hire staff, and use their skills to survive the rush!

The Coffee Rush: Piece of Cake expansion has players fulfill new orders with the help of cake cards. It adds new player boards, new order cards, beautiful 3D cakes, and new upgrades.

-description from the publisher

411558.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Dark Providence Investigators
411558.description:
A set of 5 investigators which were offered as a bonus when pre-ordering Cthulhu; Dark Providence.

This set includes 5 investigator miniatures and dashboard.


     Agent Monday
     Agent Tuesday
     Agent Wednesday
     Agent Thursday
     Agent Friday

expansions.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Fear of the Unknown
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches

411860.name: Unmatched: The Witcher – Steel and Silver
411860.description:
In battle, there are no equals.

Unmatched is a highly asymmetrical miniature fighting game for two or four players. Each hero is represented by a unique deck designed to evoke their style and legend. Tactical movement and no-luck combat resolution create a unique play experience that rewards expertise, but just when you've mastered one set, new heroes arrive to provide all new match-ups.

Unmatched: Steel and Silver has three playable characters: Geralt of Rivia, Ciri, and the Ancient Leshen. Each character comes with one or two companion tokens. Also has two battlefields from the Witcher series including the Witcher stronghold, Kaer Morhen.

411861.name: Unmatched: The Witcher – Realms Fall
411861.description:
In battle, there are no equals.

Unmatched is a highly asymmetrical miniature fighting game for two or four players. Each hero is represented by a unique deck designed to evoke their style and legend. Tactical movement and no-luck combat resolution create a unique play experience that rewards expertise, but just when you've mastered one set, new heroes arrive to provide all new match-ups.

Unmatched: Realms Fall features Eredin, Philippa, and Triss & Yennefe. and two battlefields, featuring a brand new map mechanic, from the Witcher series.

Yennefer and Triss introduce an Unmatched first: You choose who is the hero and who is the sidekick, with different special abilities for each. Philippa is a powerful sorceress and schemer, who never runs out of cards. 
King Eredin commands a horde of Wild Hunt Riders, only growing stronger when they are struck down.

412687.name: Black Rose Wars: Rebirth – Apocalypse
412687.description:
The Black Rose has summoned 4 horsemen who could destroy everything. Reports of their nine strength even reach the past! Can the power of time stop the apocalypse?

This expansion contains 4 new Magisters, 4 new schools of magic, 2 new game modes (Apocalypse and Tournament). In addition, you can now create magisters yourself.

412689.name: Black Rose Wars: Rebirth – Gaea Reborn
412689.description:
Gaea, the incarnation of the Earth Mother, has been reborn and will not rest until the world has returned to its original state - or until you defeat her.

This expansion contains 1 new Mage, 1 new Avatar, 1 new School of Magic and 2 new game modes: Paths and Scenarios.

412735.name: Black Rose Wars: Rebirth – Rotas Box
412735.description:
Rotas box is the deluxe case that contains all unlocked material during the Kickstarter campaign of Black Rose Wars: Rebirth. It is composed of 6 smaller boxes (Madness, The Silk Road, North Wind, Last Dynasty, Antiquities, and Once Upon a Time) so you can use even only theme, with reduced setup time!
Inside the Rotas Box, you will find more than 50 very detailed models (made in high-quality PVC): among them, there are 17 miniatures of 50+ mm high and 1 huge model with a height of 100 mm! Furthermore, 4 new Schools of Magic (Oracle, Heka, Chaos, and Druidic), to have much more choices in your Black Rose Wars: Rebirth games!

You can also use 12 new mages (with their personal spells and mage boards), 7 new Avatars (with their Command Cards, to manage their IA and play breathtaking semi-coop games), 6 new Room Tiles (to combine with the ones in the Core Box and add more variability) and other games material, such Quest Cards, Event Cards, Legendary Scenarios and much more!

—description from the publisher

413246.name: Bomb Busters
413246.description:
There is a bomb full of wires and the countdown has started... Who are you gonna call? YOU! To clear the bomb, you need to collaborate with your team of bomb disposal experts! Using the wires on the tile holder in front of you, try and figure out your teammates’ wires. Find and cut identical wires, but watch out, if you cut a red wire: BOOM! Use your equipment wisely to meet the varied challenges which get harder and harder. Tick tock tick tock... Will you figure it out before it’s too late?

In Bomb Busters, there is a set of 48 normal wire cards numbered 1-12 (4 of each value) with some yellow and red wire cards. These are dealt out. Each mission is different, but your goal is always the same: go through all 12 numbers without blowing up!

Players place the tiles on their stands and then take turns pointing at each others’ wires and guessing their values. If the guess is correct, the wires are cut. If not — the detonator advances! If you manage to cut all wires without blowing up — good job, the mission is completed! But if the bomb goes off - Try again!

With 66 missions, there will be:
=> 66 different ways to play depending on your moods (in order, by level of difficulty, favorite configuration)
=> 66 challenges to play over and over (even if you already blew your top!)
=> Plenty of tricky bombs which become more and more dangerous (but don’t get cut up about it!)

expansions.name: Bomb Busters: La cité de la peur Mission

413560.name: Black Rose Wars: Rebirth – Seal of Fire
413560.description:
Seal of Fire adds new game material for BRW and Rebirth, with a new Forgotten Evocation, 3 new Pets, and a YOUNG Mage, to master the most destructive and saving of the Elements.

—description from the publisher

413564.name: Black Rose Wars: Rebirth – Jukas
413564.description:
Jukas is looking for a way to free himself from the Blood of Gaea, which infested his left arm in a symbiotic relationship: even if he gained new powers, now it is slowly driving him to madness. The Black Rose Lodge may have a cure, but probably it will help Jukas only in exchange for his services.

Box content: 1x Jukas miniature (50mm), 1x Jukas Avatar card, 30x Avatar Action cards.

413565.name: Black Rose Wars: Rebirth – Irene
413565.description:
Irene is a very young apprentice, who spent her childhood inside the Lodge. She came with her mother, to work as maids in the mysterious villa: once Irene entered the Lodge, however, her life would never be the same, and destiny of power and greatness was awaiting her!

Box content: 1x Irene Miniature, 1x Irene Mage Card, 3x Irene Personal Spell Card.

Irene was earlier released under the title "The Secret of the Lodge", a product that also includes a book with a background story.

414160.name: Black Rose Wars: Rebirth – Dreadforge
414160.description:
The Lodge Forge has been lighted again and an ancient threat has been awakened. A new opponent is making his way through the ravaged rooms of the Lodge, and a hell of magma and flames is about to break loose! This rich expansion adds Magma, a huge new Avatar, The new cyclopic Mage Etna, and the new Forge School of Magic to your games!

Also included are the cards necessary to add Magma as a monster hunt in Nova Aetas Renaissance.

414161.name: Black Rose Wars: Rebirth – Deadly Mask
414161.description: The Mages of the schools of Alchemy and Shamanism join the war for the control of the ruins of the Black Rose Lodge! With Deadly Masks expansion, you will be able to play Rebirth with 5 or 6 players!

414317.name: Harmonies
414317.description:
In Harmonies, build landscapes by placing colored tokens and create habitats for your animals. To earn the most points and win the game, incorporate the habitats in your landscapes wisely and have as many animals as you can settle there.

Starting with the first player and proceeding clockwise, each player will choose a set of 3 terrain tokens from the central area to place on their personal board. They may optionally choose an Animal card from the 5 displayed and/or place an Animal cube from their Animal card(s) on any completed patterns on their board that match their personal Animal cards. There is a 4-card limit per player. After their turn, refill with a new set of 3 tokens and a new Animal card if needed.

Placement of the terrain tokens will depend on the personal Animal card goals, and scoring rules for the various terrain types (mountain, field, forest, etc). For example, mountain tiles score based on how high they are (1 tile scores 1, while 3 tiles stacked score 7), but the mountain scores zero if it is not adjacent to at least one other mountain. If all the cubes on a given Animal card have been placed, the card is set aside and a new card can be drawn. The cards are scored at game end based on the highest number that isn't covered by a cube.

The games ends when there are no tokens left in the bag to refill the central area, or at least one players has 2 or fewer empty spaces on their player board. Play continues until all players have had an equal turn that round. The player with the highest points is the winner.

Optionally, you can use Nature's Spirit cards for richer gameplay. During setup, each player chooses 1 of 2 spirit cards and places a Spirit cube on the card. They follow the same placement rules as Animal cards, but tend to have an ongoing effect once completed. The spirit card does count towards the 4-card hand limit.

—description from the publisher

414546.name: The Cats of Mont Saint Michel
414546.description:
Welcome to The Cats of Mont Saint Michel. A dark time has fallen on the place and the humans who inhabit it.

The Cats of Mont Saint Michel is a miniatures solo/cooperative campaign game set in the historical monastery Saint Michel and just before the French revolution. You will be playing directly on the coil bound scenario book and using 12 sided dice for combat and collecting cards for loot, skills and powers. The game plays out over a series of linked scenarios forming a campaign and ongoing story. Each previous scenario in the campaign affects the start of the next.

As you play each scenario, your hero will come closer to reaching their ultimate goal of ridding the Abbey of the villainous rats and their brethren. Along the way, they will need to defeat swarms of cockroaches, warrior rats and other foul beings. They will also be gaining experience and unlocking unique skills.

This game takes several sittings to complete but you can save your progress easily.

—description from the designer

415843.name: Puerto Rico 1897: Special Edition
415843.description:
A classic board game is coming back in a unique Special Edition.

Puerto Rico is one of the most iconic strategy games in the world. In this game, you take different roles, including industrious builder, clever trader, stalwart captain, opportunistic prospector, and more. Bolster your wealth and reputation by carefully building your city, harvesting goods, and strategically governing the island of Puerto Rico. The player with the most prosperous island wins!

The Special Edition offers enhanced components and artwork, with an improved layout and general game feel. It includes all the previous expansions, a new expansion, and a solo mode! Some versions of this edition will include playmat, deluxe components, and/or 3D terrain components.

—description from the publisher

families.name: Versions & Editions: Big Box Versions of Individual Games

compilations.name: Puerto Rico 1897
Puerto Rico: Buccaneer
Puerto Rico: Expansion I – New Buildings
Puerto Rico: Expansion II – The Nobles
Puerto Rico: Festival en Puerto Rico

415878.name: Thunder Road: Vendetta – Carnival of Chaos
415878.description:
Carnival of Chaos is an expansion for Thunder Road: Vendetta (or Thunder Road: Vendetta – Maximum Chrome) that offers a new way to play. Players race their cars into the arena, collecting wild party favors, powerful super-weapons, and precious scrap along the way. This expansion also includes a full set of vehicles and a dashboard, so you can play with a fifth player using this expansion or in the regular game.

Unlike a regular game of Thunder Road: Vendetta, the winner of the Carnival of Chaos is the surviving player who has the most scrap at the end of the game. There is no finish line.

—description from the publisher

expansions.name: Thunder Road: Vendetta  – Turbo Tina's Swag Pack

416851.name: Castle Combo
416851.description:
Castle Combo is a tableau-building game that combines simplicity with deep, engaging gameplay, offering highly satisfying experiences.

Each player will spend coins to draft 9 cards from 2 open markets on the table (the lower and upper city), creating along the game a 3x3 square of people interacting with each other to trigger instant effects and end-of-game bonuses.

Each turn, you add a character to your tableau — a seemingly straightforward action that packs a punch regarding strategic decisions. You'll need to carefully manage your Keys to influence the Messenger pawn at critical moments, as it controls which characters are available for recruitment from two different areas – peasants and nobles.

Balancing your Gold reserves is equally important, ensuring you can afford the characters that best suit your strategy throughout the game. Selecting the right characters is crucial to maximising their immediate effects and the points they will contribute at the game's end. Finally, carefully arranging these characters on your 3x3 board is key to unlocking their full potential.

After everyone has played 9 turns (i.e., everyone has 9 characters in front of them), the player with the most points in their tableau wins the game.

expansions.name: Castle Combo: Out of the Oubliette!

417155.name: Kyoto no Neko
417155.description:
In Kyoto no Neko, 2 to 4 players are kittens who explore the modern-day city of Kyoto, Japan through a series of independent, replayable scenarios. In each scenario, players must fulfill a variety of missions that represent typical cat activities, from befriending a school boy to fighting an aggressive stray cat, or stealing the food from other player's dinner bowl. During each game, every player will evolve, developing their skills and gaining the ability to explore new parts of the map by climbing on bushes and rooftops.

Using a system of skills, Kyoto no Neko will see each player interact with some of Kyoto's inhabitants, both animal and human.  Each turn provides the opportunity to uncover something new about the city as players will reveal elements from little insects to specific objects or denizens of Kyoto. While some of these elements are represented by cardboard tiles, others come as standees, ensuring a stunning visual presence.

Kyoto no Neko is set to release at Essen Spiel 2024.

418059.name: SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence
418059.description:
In SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence, you lead a scientific institution tasked with searching for traces of life beyond planet Earth. The game draws inspiration from current or emerging technologies and efforts in space exploration. Players will explore nearby planets and their moons by launching probes from Earth while taking advantage of ever-shifting planetary positions. Decide whether to land on their surfaces to collect valuable samples or stay in orbit for a broader survey. Additionally, by directing your telescopes to gaze into distant star systems, you may detect traces of alien signals or undiscovered exoplanets, and collect promising data to examine and study back home.

Back on Earth, you can invest in upgrading your equipment so you can analyze incoming data more efficiently, boost your telescope signal capacity, or increase your supply of resources—all to expand the scope of your search that could lead to a discovery of extraterrestrial life forms. Finding traces of extraterrestrial life is only a matter of time—utilize the resources you have at your disposal strategically and you may well end up being the one to make the biggest scientific contribution towards advancing our understanding of alien life within our galaxy.

You will also make use of over 200 cards to aid your efforts or focus your research in a particular direction for additional bonuses and rewards. Each card has unique effects and illustrations and depicts real-life technologies, projects, and discoveries (like the ISS, Large Hadron Collider, Perseverance rover, Voyager probe, and many more).

The game is played in five rounds. The player with the starting player marker takes the first turn of the round. Players take turns in clockwise order, skipping any players who have already passed for the round. At the end of round 5, the final score is calculated and the player with the most points wins.

SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence pays homage to space and planetary exploration, astronomy, the ongoing search for signs of life in the vastness of space, and efforts to understand the nature of life in the universe.

—description from the publisher

expansions.name: SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence – DLR Promo Card
SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence – Drake Equation Promo Card
SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence – Gateway to Mars Promo Card
SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence – Pluto Promo Card
SETI: Space Agencies – Space Agencies Promo Card

418354.name: Babylon
418354.description:
In the 6th century BCE, Nebuchadnezzar II, king of Babylon, wanted to honor his young wife, Amytis of Media, with magnificent gardens featuring a multitude of beautifully scented flowers, so he called on the most eminent architects in his kingdom to test their ingenuity and realize his vision of creating what would become one of the seven wonders of the ancient world.

In Babylon, you take on the role of an eminent architect. Dig the quarry for the best materials, and use them wisely to build your gardens. At the end of the game, the player who unveils the most impressive design before the king will be declared the winner and crowned the greatest architect in the kingdom. Although Babylon is accessible to the whole family, it is also very popular with heavy gamers, due to a large number of optimization possibilities.

The game box, representing the quarry from which you will draw your construction materials, is placed in the center of the table. On your turn, take a Terrace tile of your choice from the quarry and receive, depending on its location, a variable number of pillars. Use these pillars to place your tile on your personal board and, if you can, beautify your garden with different decorative elements. Build your terraces to go from floor to floor and decorate them as much as possible. At the end of the game, each decorative element will give you victory points depending on the floor where it is located.

—description from the publisher

families.name: Constructions: The Hanging Gardens of Babylon

418470.name: Endeavor: Deep Sea Deluxe Edition
418470.description:
The Deluxe version contains the following enhancements to the components and gameplay:

     Recessed player mats
     Shaped and screen-printed meeples
     Gametrayz insert
     5th player components
     Robotic Wanderer mini expansion
     Orca reintroduction mini expansion
     Underwave Academy mini expansion

expansions.name: Endeavor: Deep Sea – Investigating the Biodiversity in Bounty Through Promo Card

compilations.name: Endeavor: Deep Sea
Endeavor: Deep Sea – Deluxe Upgrade Pack

418826.name: Dark Blood
418826.description:
Dark Blood plunges players into the abyss of darkness, where they embody powerful asymmetrical cults striving for dominance over a hapless village. Whether as the cult of the Demonologist, Warlock, Necromancer, or Doomsayer, players must adeptly recruit villagers or harvest their blood to empower their sinister rituals.

Through a fusion of Area Majority, Worker placement and Resource gathering, they vie with one another, navigating the perilous path of corruption, enhancing their Rituals, and staining various parts of the village to seize territories and augment their Taint (Victory Points). With each round introducing fresh challenges and opportunities, players must judiciously balance their strategies to outmaneuver their adversaries and emerge as the foremost cult as the fifth round draws to a close.

During each round, players delve into their Ritual Book, serving as their player board, to oversee their Cultists, amass Resources, and upgrade their Rituals. The main board grants access to the five pivotal locations where the four cults will contend for control, eventually corrupting them.


    During the Upkeep phase, these locations undergo random variations in the number of available Peasants, the resources they yield and more... 
    In the Placement phase, all cults place their workers (Cultist Miniatures) in these locations, determining the actions their cult can execute in each one. The majority in each location dictates not only special actions but also the initiative in which these actions will unfold. 
    In the Resolve phase, each cult assigns their cultists to diverse actions, from resource gathering for Ritual upgrades to hanging peasants at the Tree of the Damned to bolster their Dark Favor. 
    In the final phase, players Defile the land and bid their accumulated Blood to dominate the most corrupted location. The number of Sigils placed by each player significantly influences the ultimate outcome. 


As the fifth round concludes, the locations you corrupted, along with other factors such as your cult's size, upgraded Rituals, secret quest, concealed Taint and more, will determine the prevailing cult.

419158.name: Kemet: Rise of the Gods
419158.description:
Kemet: Rise of the Gods brings various new and long-awaited features to Kemet: Blood and Sand.

This expansion includes: Gods mode, Team mode, a 6 player mode, a solo mode, and two new tile colors, Amber and Amethyst, with various other modules, content and quality-of-life components.  The Rise of the Gods expansion will come with a new rulebook (including the core rules and all the rules for the new modules) and 6 new player aids.

—description from the publisher

expansions.name: Kemet: Blood and Sand – Kickstarter Edition

compilations.name: Kemet: Blood and Sand – The Baboon

419279.name: Arcs: Leaders & Lore Pack
419279.description:
Explore unique, tricky strategies in the Arcs base game with new Leaders, and add wild twists to both the Arcs base and campaign games with new Lore.

—description form the publisher

Initially known as the "More to Explore Pack" during the Kickstarter campaign.

419633.name: Trash or Cash
419633.description:
In Trash or Cash, players take on the role of scavengers in an underground world. Each turn presents a massive garbage puzzle, and players must decide whether to accept the potentially space-consuming puzzle piece. Declining incurs a compensation fee, while accepting grants the full compensation. Players must strategically manage their space, earning additional compensation for collecting pieces of the same series.

Various module cards are also provided to add more challenges for players, ensuring each game offers a unique experience. Balancing the accumulation of garbage with financial sustainability becomes crucial as players navigate this intricate underworld.

419742.name: Dead By Daylight: The Board Game – Malicious Expansion
419742.description:
Enhance your Dead By Daylight: The Board Game experience with this expansion! Play as one of the new Survivors and utilize their unique perks to escape from a new cabal of terrifying Killers with horrifying abilities you've never seen before!

Play as 4 new resourceful Survivors with their own unique perks!
Play as 3 new Killers with horrifying powers that defy logic to hunt your prey!
Explore 2 new twisted realms within The Fog - Forsaken Boneyard and Withered Isle.
Bring the game to life with 10 hauntingly detailed miniature figurines!

—description from the publisher

expansions.name: Dead by Daylight: The Board Game
Dead by Daylight: The Board Game – Collector's Edition

419925.name: Factoria: Forbidden Walkers
419925.description:
Experience the aftermath of Factoria, where the game ended at 100G!

The Factoria: Forbidden Walkers expansion lets you enjoy the devastating expansion of an enlarged reproduction system with new complexity. Included are:


     Special abilities for owners of Legendary Gear, which increases the competition for Legendary Gear and providing a catch-up mechanic
     Addition of LV7 and LV8 relics
     Addition of overpowered, forbidden technical books


These additions created a dangerous balance that could go out of control at the slightest mistake mistake. The expansion is not recommended for first-time players, but once you experience it, it's so appealing that you won't be able to go back to regular play... This is a dangerous expansion set that everyone who considers themselves a gamer should try!

—description from the publisher (translated)

420321.name: The White Castle: Matcha
420321.description:
The tea ceremony lies at the heart of Japanese culture, giving life the most essential and elemental concepts of hospitality, respect, and Zen philosophy. There, they believe that tea, which came from China in the 13th century, resolved the health problems of the Buddhist monks who drank it. Over the years, the tea ceremony evolved to offer the samurai a place of calm, far from the chaos of the battlefield.

In The White Castle: Matcha, you will have to deal with a new place in which to influence the court using new members of your clan. Having members of your clan in good seats within the Chashitsu (tea room) will help you achieve a greater level of influence within the court of Himeji. Also, you will have one additional action each round. Will that be enough?

The first printing includes The White Castle: Promo 4 packaged inside the expansion box. It is currently not available by itself.
To be played with the base game and the Matcha expansion.

Contains 3 Die tiles, each of which with Chasen on the back. When setting up the game, replace the 3 Die tiles that grant a Resource of your choice with these 3 new tiles.

—description from the publisher

expansions.name: Gisei (fan expansion for The White Castle)

421006.name: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth
421006.description:
A dark rumour rises from Mordor. The Eye turns to Middle-earth. The hour has come. The Fellowship is reunited. The Heroes prepare for battle. Will you play as the Fellowship of the Ring to defend the free races and destroy the One Ring? Or will you play as Sauron and pursue Frodo and Sam while deploying your hordes to the gates of the enemy cities? The destiny of Middle-earth is in your hands!

A game plays over 3 successive chapters that unfold similarly.
On your turn, strengthen your Skills, hoard your treasure, stretch your presence across Middle-earth, rally Races to your cause, or advance the Quest of the Ring.

				
				
					Turn OverviewIn each chapter players take cards from a display of face-down and face-up cards arranged at the start of a round. A player can take a card only if it's available, that is not partially covered by any other cards. Players can either play the card, paying its cost and placing it in their play area, obtaining its benefit, or discard the card and take as many coins from the reserve as the current chapter.

Players can also take a Landmark tile from one of the faceup tiles, paying its cost placing it in their play area. They will be able to immediately place a Fortress pawn on the corresponding region of the central board and benefit from its other effects.

				
				
					Victory ConditionsImmediately win the game by fulfilling one of the 3 victory conditions:

				
				
					Quest of the Ring
     For the Fellowship: If Frodo and Sam reach Mount Doom, they destroy the One Ring and you immediately win the game.
     For Sauron: If the Nazgûl catch Frodo and Sam, they seize the One Ring and you immediately win the game.


				
				
					Support of the RacesIf any player gathers 6 different Race symbols on their Green cards, they rally the support of the Races of Middle-earth and immediately win the game

				
				
					Conquering Middle-earthIf a player is present in all 7 regions (with a Fortress and/or at least 1 Unit), they dominate Middle-earth and immediately win the game.

If none of these three victory conditions are achieved by the end of chapter 3, the player who is present in the most regions of Middle-earth (with a Fortress and/or at least 1 Unit) wins the game. In case of tie, share the victory.

families.name: Versions & Editions: Versions with IP after the original release

expansions.name: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-Earth – Allies
The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth – Grond Promo Tile
The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth – The Shire Promo Tile

421471.name: Deep Regrets: Lamentable Tentacles Mini-Expansion
421471.description:
18 additional fish cards to add to the base game, all featuring far too many tentacles and everybody's favorite great old one. Compatible with solo mode!

—description from the designer

421852.name: Thingstead
421852.description:
The year is 1130. An assembly is about to be called to elect a new chieftain of your Viking village. There is only one opponent who could threaten your election. Over the next few days you must balance your time between the clans and the Thingstead (where the elders are gathered) in order to ensure the votes go to you instead of your rival. At the end of the game, the elders of the Thingstead call a vote and decide a winner. The battle for power has begun. Who will the Seven Elders choose to be the next Chieftain? Manage your hand of cards, play them wisely and win your place as leader of the tribe without dealing a single blow of the axe!

Players take turns completing one action at a time. Play continues until one of the following conditions is fulfilled: One Player has locked 3 Elders or the draw deck is empty and both players are out of cards.

To calculate the final score, players add up the points gained from influencing Elders and for each Clan they control. The player with the most points is the winner! In the case of a tie, the player with the most Followers among the Elder cards wins.

421904.name: The Vale of Eternity: Artifacts
421904.description:
The Vale of Eternity: Artifacts, an expansion for The Vale of Eternity, adds 28 creature cards with new effects to the deck, as well as artifacts that players draft during the hunting phase at the start of each round.

In more detail, at the start of a round reveal twice as many creatures as players in the usual way, then starting with the first player, each player drafts an artifact without their marker on it by placing their marker on that artifact. (In effect, you can't draft the same artifact you had the previous round.) Some artifacts have instant effects you use immediately, others give you a permanent effect that entire round, and others grant you an action that you can use once on a turn. After drafting artifacts, players draft creature cards in the usual way.

When using artifacts, the victory threshold for the game is now 80 points instead of 60, although the game still ends after ten rounds regardless of the score.

422890.name: Eden's Shadow
422890.description:
A girl in search of paradise
Angel of black wings who has fallen to earth
Ring-bound demons
Twins born between angels and demons
The Dark House and the Cult

Guided by stone tablets, the heroes visited the remains of a dream that God was born in the past.
Is it salvation that awaits them there, or...

423177.name: Sky Team: Turbulence
423177.description:
In Sky Team: Turbulence, terrible weather conditions and technical incidents will be the order of the day for your landings.

Take your seat in the cockpit and test your skills in 20 scenarios that are even more demanding! Turbulence introduces new rules and new modules, such as Turbulence, Low Visibility, and Alarms, that will add depth and diversity to your Sky Team base game.
Now boarding for such wonderful destinations as Beijing, Madrid, Warsaw, Sydney, Cape Town, Kyiv, and Saint Martin.

Hang on to your seats. It is going to be a bumpy ride!

Turbulence is an expansion for the co-operative two-player game Sky Team

—description from the publisher

compilations.name: Sky Team: DUS Düsseldorf
Sky Team: MAD Madrid-Barajas
Sky Team: NZIR Ice Runway
Sky Team: TER Lajes, Açores
Пілоти: KBP Бориспіль (Sky Team: KBP Boryspil)

423519.name: Nucleum: Court of Progress
423519.description:
As the 19th century draws to a close, the monarchies of Europe struggle to stay relevant in this rapidly changing age. Whether it’s the court of King Frederik in Saxony or the court of the aging Queen Victoria of the British Empire trying to maintain rule over the faraway riches of Australia, they must all contend with the rising political forces clamoring to secure their piece of the pie in the nuclear revolution. As ideologies clash in parliaments, entrepreneurs like yourself must do their best to make sure they have plenty of friends in the halls of power.

Nucleum: Court of Progress introduces several new concepts and rule changes that can be added to the base game and/or Nucleum: Australia. Via the new Court action players get a chance to send their workers to political parties and even become their leaders to gain various benefits. Joining a Party provides instant rewards and opportunities to earn VP during King's Day Scoring, which is now much more significant. The expansion also adds two new Experiments, new action tiles, contracts, etc.

—description from the publisher

423733.name: Terrorscape: Putrefied Enmity
423733.description:
The crypt has arisen — and with it, a queen whose wrath refuses rest.

When a cursed tomb is disturbed, its Immortal Queen rises, her undead command echoing through collapsed corridors and blocked hallways that twist and trap the unwary. Three members of a production house — Ophelia Romero the reporter, Dylan Wan the cameraman, and Caleb Peele the producer — must fight or flee through shattered passageways as the Queen and her soldiers stalk their every step. In Putrefied Enmity, survival means navigating ruins, dodging decay, and outsmarting a relentless horror that will not let its secrets rest.

Inside the box:
- 1 Killer game board with map "The Tomb"
- 1 Survivor game board with map "The Tomb"
- 1 Killer miniature (Immortal Queen)
- 1 Killer board
- 12 Zombie miniatures 
- 3 Survivor miniatures (Ophelia Romero, Dylan Wan, Caleb Peele)
- 3 Survivor boards
- 13 killer skill cards
- 7 item cards
- 11 tokens (1 Relic Chamber, 3 Poison, 3 Encouragement, 1 Toughness, 3 Killer Assistance)
- 8 Collapse tiles
- 1 Special rule card
- 1 Expansion #4 rulebook

423742.name: Dark Blood: Inquisitor Module
423742.description:
The Inquisitor will hunt all cultists, introducing a new layer of difficulty to the game.

This Module consists of:

The Inquisitor Miniature
    The 3 Inquisitor Wooden Hex
    The Rules for the Inquisitor competitive mod.
    The Rules for the Inquisitor co-operative mod.

—description from the publisher

424219.name: Zenith
424219.description:
In the far-off future, the solar system is inhabited by 3 races: Humans, Robots, and Animods. 
Civilization runs off of Zenithium, a clean and renewable energy source, but coexistence is a struggle. 
Your goal: unite the planets to gain control of the senate!

Players will struggle to gain Influence on the 5 planets: Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars, and Jupiter. This Influence is represented by discs in different colors.

In Zenith, there are 3 victory conditions:

     Absolute victory: Gain 3 Influence discs from the same planet.
     Democratic victory: Gain 4 Influence discs from strictly different planets.
     Popular victory: Gain 5 Influence discs (from any planets).


The game ends immediately as soon as one player meets 1 of these three conditions.

—description from the publisher

425063.name: Nucleum: Patrons Set
425063.description:
This mini expansion brings Patron Cards into the game.

Each Patron Card belongs to the specific Experiment board. In the base game those Experiments are distinguished by letters only. Now, on every Patron card you can see the occupation of each Patron associated with the specific Experiment along with their description and image depicting them. From now on, Experiments will be referred to using names of their Patrons introduced by this mini expansion:

Experiment A -> Banker
Experiment B -> Captain of Industry
Experiment C -> Mistress Inventor
Experiment D -> Junior Minister
Experiment E -> Councilor
Experiment F -> Madame Engineer

425315.name: Nucleum: Neons Promo
425315.description:
Each player is dealt 3 Neon tokens.
These tokens can be used to increase the electricity cost of your energize action to gain more achievement tokens.

425316.name: Nucleum: New Contracts Promo
425316.description: Three new contracts to be added to the game, focused on progressing on the income tracks.

425445.name: Sweet Lands
425445.description:
Welcome to “Sweet Lands”, the kingdom of delightful confections! The former king has succumbed to his gluttonous love for sweets, leaving behind a final decree. Summoned by this royal edict, you and your fellow players are challenged to build the most magnificent city — and if you succeed, you will ascend as the new ruler of Sweet Lands. Gather the support of various townsfolk and navigate through fierce competition to create the richest and most prosperous city of sweets!

Sweet Lands is a heavyweight Euro-style game with over 200 cards, 14 unique characters, and 449 wooden tokens. During the game, each player develops Cities on their Map Board whilst advancing on their Prosperity Tracks. After 5 rounds, the game ends and the player with the most Victory Points is the winner!

—description from the publisher

425623.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Godzilla Vs Cthulhu
425623.description:
You can choose to add Godzilla to any game. He isn't an enemy; investigators cannot interact with him. Think of him more as an uncontrollable force of nature. He starts in his Unruly Behavior phase, and every turn you roll a die to determine his actions. He might roar, causing investigators to lose sanity, stomp around, killing enemies and leaving Debris tokens that hinder investigators' movement, or even use his atomic breath to place fire and inflict wounds on all figures in a single zone.

Once the Elder One is summoned, Godzilla shifts to his Territorial Behavior. Things escalate as investigators witness a Kaiju battle between Godzilla and the Elder One unfolding before them. Godzilla still acts every turn, but now he moves towards the Elder One to confront him. However, the Elder One doesn't just take attacks passively; every time Godzilla acts, the Elder One strikes back, either physically or mentally, affecting Godzilla's sanity. Godzilla doesn't have a Health track; instead, each time the Elder One hits him, he becomes distressed. When the Distress track reaches its maximum, Godzilla gives up and retreats, causing the investigators to lose the game. Therefore, when Godzilla begins fighting the Elder One, investigators must assist him because if Godzilla retreats before all stages of the Elder One are defeated, they lose.

expansions.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Fear of the Unknown
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches

425706.name: Dorasure: Little Great Adventure
425706.description: Dorasure's 10th expansion adds one new character (Tamer) and a new game mechanic in the form of three small companions. These small companions will provide some big help and become your powerful allies against the dragon.

425707.name: Dorasure: EXTeRA
425707.description: This special expansion adds a new "Zombie" character to the characters "Dragon Fist" and "Land God" from the coterie magazine "TEARDORA" by Tera Akai, who is in charge of the main artwork. Go on adventures with characters with romantic abilities!

426129.name: Dune: Imperium – Bloodlines
426129.description:
The Great Houses of the Imperium live and die by their lineage. Plots unfold over generations as Emperors build dynasties, and the Bene Gesserit weave prophecy into reality. As alliances rise and fall, leaders face a single question: How far will you go to secure your bloodline?

Bloodlines expands both Dune: Imperium and Uprising with powerful new tools to achieve victory. Recruit Sardaukar Commanders to bolster your fighting force. Unlock the potential of all-new Tech tiles. New Leaders, Contracts, and cards open more strategic possibilities than ever before. War sweeps across the universe, and only the strongest Bloodlines will survive.

—description from the publisher

expansions.name: Dune: Imperium – Ruthless Leadership Promo Card

426978.name: Ark Nova: Zoo Map Pack 2
426978.description:
Ark Nova: Zoo Map Pack 2 features five new zoo designs.

The “Tournament 1” design is on all four game boards so that players can compete with the same layout.

Four different zoo boards with new and interesting abilities are on the opposite sides of the Tournament game boards:

Artificial Intelligence
Caves
Drawing Board
Lagoon

427388.name: Tend
427388.description:
In Tend, players take on the role of a pioneer working for the Zenith corporation to start a homestead on a new alien world.

Tend is a "flip and write" game where players are each building up their own farm and collecting the greatest selection of goods to send back to Zenith HQ for study. All players will be using the same deck of action cards each round to simultaneously take actions on their own sheets.

As the game progresses new cards will be added to the shared deck, changing what actions are available for the whole table throughout the course of the game.

Players earn victory points for collecting badges, completing season objectives, being the best neighbor, and filling up their Cargo Manifest with goods to send back to Zenith HQ. In the end, the player with the most victory points wins!

—description from the designer

428401.name: Terraforming Mars: Cardboard Map Box Big Box Extension
428401.description:
Adds the 4 new maps on 2 cardboard maps (Utopia Planitia, Terra Cimmeria, Vastitas Borealis, Amazonis Planitia) and an extension for the big box to store everything in one box again.

Contains:

     Terraforming Mars: Amazonis & Vastitas
     Terraforming Mars: Utopia & Cimmeria
     Terraforming Mars: Big Box Extension


—user summary

compilations.name: Terraforming Mars: Amazonis & Vastitas
Terraforming Mars: Utopia & Cimmeria

428511.name: Terraforming Mars: Utopia & Cimmeria
428511.description:
A double-sided game board presenting two new maps for Terraforming Mars, each with new milestones and awards:


     Terra Cimmeria - Terraform the cratered highland region of Mars.
     Utopia Planitia - Terraform the northern lava plain of Mars.

compilations.name: Terraforming Mars: Terra Cimmeria – Big Board Edition
Terraforming Mars: Utopia Planitia – Big Board Edition
Terraforming Mars: Cardboard Map Box Big Box Extension

428620.name: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth – The Shire Promo Tile
428620.description:
The Shire - Play a visible card, from the current chapter, to your play area, whether it’s available or not.
Unlike other Landmarks, do not place a Fortress on the central board.

expansions.name: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth

428879.name: Arkham Horror: The Card Game – The Drowned City: Campaign Expansion
428879.description:
It was supposed to be one last job. At the behest of shadowy antiquarian Randall Tillinghast—who presents them with an offer they can’t refuse—our investigators travel to the South Pacific and the vast, alien city of R’lyeh. However, the more they explore, the more terrors they discover, and as a looming sense of dread grows, they find themselves—and all of Arkham—faced with a colossal threat.

The time has come. Cthulhu has awakened, and Arkham will never be the same.

—description from the publisher

families.name: Game: Arkham Horror – The Card Game
Series: Arkham Horror Files (Fantasy Flight Games)

expansions.name: Arkham Horror: The Card Game (Revised Core Set)

428880.name: Arkham Horror: The Card Game – The Drowned City: Investigator Expansion
428880.description:
The people of Arkham have weathered many threats. Eldritch horrors, dark cults, and ghoulish hauntings have plagued the city for years, and each incident was resolved by brave investigators from all walks of life. But now, Arkham faces its greatest threat to date, and it falls to our intrepid investigators to come together and ensure the city’s survival.

The Drowned City Investigator Expansion features six new investigators for Arkham Horror: The Card Game and adds a trove of new player cards and options for deckbuilding, including brand-new “Specialist” cards that play off investigators’ traits. Protect the vulnerable as the trawler, Marion Tavares; draw inspiration from horrors as the poet, Lucius Galloway; fend off monsters with a hail of bullets as the gangster, Micheal McGlen; blur the line between science and mysticism as the parapsychologist, Agatha Crane; control your fate with prophetic visions as the writer, Gloria Goldberg; and come prepared to weather any storm as the lawyer, George Barnaby.

—description from the publisher

families.name: Game: Arkham Horror – The Card Game

expansions.name: Arkham Horror: The Card Game (Revised Core Set)

428908.name: San Juan 1897: Special Edition
428908.description:
Discover a new version of the classic card game - San Juan! The cards have been given new layouts and artwork, with some buildings renamed to better align with the Puerto Rico 1897 Special Edition.

The game revolves around building production and special buildings, with cards used both as currency and goods.

This edition was originally announced as containing all previously released cards, including The Hut [first introduced in San Juan (Second Edition)], and the first San Juan edition”s expansion, San Juan: The New Buildings & The Events, [whose buildings had also been included in San Juan (Second Edition)]. However, though all the previously released buildings were included in the final product (with The Hut being renamed to Bohio), the event cards were not.

implementations.name: San Juan: The New Buildings & The Events

compilations.name: San Juan (Second Edition)

428947.name: Kaito & Diamond
428947.description:
The world’s richest man is going to exhibit the world’s  best diamond, and all the kaitos are coming here. Even if you try your best, you can’t lose to the other thieves, so steal as much as you can, and if you can’t steal it, then try to make noise to attract the police to come and find out who can steal the diamond, and who will be caught by the police!

The person who plays the biggest card in each round will not only steal the diamond, but will also be ambushed by the police who have been lured to follow you this round... Whether or not you can steal perfectly in full view of the public is up to you!

—description from the designer

Kaito & Diamond is a trick-taking game where every player takes on the role of a daring Kaito, competing to steal valuable diamonds each round. The player who plays the highest-valued card wins the diamond but also catches the attention of the guard.

At the end of the game, the Kaito with the most attention is immediately disqualified, and the remaining players add up their diamond points to decide the ultimate winner.

429405.name: Orloj: The Prague Astronomical Clock
429405.description:
From the heart of Prague’s Old Town, the ancient Astronomical Clock, known as the Orloj, marks the passage of time with its intricate mechanism and enigmatic figures. A marvel of medieval technology that has endured to this day.

In this game, you take on the role of a master builder competing to leave your mark on history by adding the legendary and majestic calendar to the ancient Orloj. Precision, balance, and knowledge of the cosmos will be the keys to completing this complex task.

With every gear, sphere, and zodiac sign you assemble, you will be one step closer to finishing this masterpiece that will mark time in the city for generations.

Each turn, players will place workers on the clock's dial to gain resources and perform actions with the goal of building the Orloj calendar. In addition to hiring assistants, during the game, players will construct the apostles' carillon and develop their knowledge across three tracks where experience will enhance their abilities.

The game will end when the calendar is completed. The player with the most harmony points will win the game.

—description from the publisher

429797.name: The Bad Karmas and the Curse of Cthulhu
429797.description:
The Bad Karmas and The Curse of Cthulhu is the new installment in The Bad Karmas series. Once again the fate of humanity is at stake but this time the fight is against Cthulhu and many other Great Old Ones!

In this fourth, standalone volume our beloved heroes find themselves in the 1920s, a world where obscure cults and cosmic horrors are spreading, and ancient, otherworldly powers are awakening. This time, The Bad Karmas have to keep their sanity and avoid falling into madness. As the madness rises, heroes can unlock special “last resort” actions that could help during the fight, but by reaching their madness limit they will suffer major setbacks for the remainder of the battle.

The Bad Karmas and The Curse of Cthulhu is a cooperative tactical boss-battle board game, made even more immersive thanks to integration with the Teburu system, which automatically handles rules, effects, and story developments. This allows players to focus on tactics, cooperation, and narrative choices without slowing down the flow of the game.
Work together to defeat the Great Old Ones who evolve and respond in real-time to player actions, and live a one-of-a-kind, immersive gaming experience.

Volume 4 box includes:
- 3 unique Great Old Ones (Cthulhu, Hastur, Ithaqua)
- 4 new Golden Age Heroes (the Gangster, the Explorer, the Detective, the Mystic)
- 2 double-sided board maps
- environmental elements standees

—description from the publisher

429845.name: Jisogi: Anime Studio Tycoon
429845.description:
Jisogi is a worker-placement board game. The theme is Anime, more specifically the hard-working folks and the crushing business behind it.

In this tycoon-style game, players use Staff members (cards placed in front of their personal Studio board) to select from a range of available actions (limited by the type of Staff). Their objective is to release an original Anime composed of 3 Script parts (Setting, Plot, and Twist). Whenever released, players will gain resources and points according to their popularity - determined by the technical level of the Anime and how many genre matches they have to rotating Trend cards.

"Jisogi" comes from 自転車操業, jitenshasōgyō, an expression that refers to barely keeping a business going (an analogy that a bicycle falls over when its wheels cease rotating). Get ready for a challenging tycoon-style game where you'll hustle to make your dream Anime against all odds.

430027.name: SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence – Pluto Promo Card
430027.description:
A promo card representing Pluto. It reads:

If you have a probe in the outermost ring, you may use a satellite or lander action to place that probe on Pluto.

430036.name: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth – Grond Promo Tile
430036.description:
Promo given for the early buy in store.

During setup, after revealing 3 Landmark tiles, shuffle the Grond tile with the other remaining Landmark tiles and form a stack, facedown.

Grond - Remove 1 enemy Fortress from any region.
If enemy Units are present in the region, they must retreat to a single adjacent region.
Note: If this retreat triggers a conflict, resolve it as normal.
Finally, place 1 Fortress and 1 Unit in the region.

expansions.name: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth

430092.name: Inferno: Papal Bulls – Mini Expansion
430092.description:
A 10-card Inferno mini expansion, Papal Bulls, granting each player a superpower or the ability to perform a powerful action once per game.

Comes inside the deluxe edition but also available separately for those who pick up the retail edition preorder bundle.

compilations.name: Inferno: Collector’s Edition

430106.name: Babylon: Goodie Cards
430106.description:
Setup:
• Take the 4 cards that match the flower on your personal player board.
• Place the 2 vertical cards along the left side of your board, and the 2 horizontal boards along the top of your board.

2. HOW TO PLAY
There are no changes to the base game rules.
Build your garden normally. The promo cards do not introduce special placement rules.

3. FINAL SCORING
• During final scoring, for each of the 8 rows and 8 columns, gain 1 victory point (VP) if the element shown is present (and visible) at least 1 time in the row/column.
• If the element is present multiple times, you still only gain 1 VP.
• The level on which the element is built does not matter

However, carefully placing decorative elements in your garden will help you gain extra points

430702.name: Black Rose Wars: Duel – Void
430702.description:
Black Rose Wars: Duel – Void is a game of mage duels set in the Black Rose Lodge, a sentient place where a powerful supernatural being, the Black Rose, resides.

In this place, the most powerful mages in the world gather, learn, and challenge each other to determine who is the best among them, the one who will become the next Grand Magister of the Lodge.

This game allows two players to compete in a terrifying battle of magic and teaches the fundamentals of this game's older brother, Black Rose Wars: choosing and planning spells and actions from a common deck and managing their own evocations and resources.

This game is independent of Black Rose Wars; most of the material in this box can be used to expand Black Rose Wars, but the reverse is not always possible.

—description from the publisher

expansions.name: Black Rose Wars: Duel – Void Preorder Promo

431228.name: Dwellings of Eldervale: Oracle Hex Tile
431228.description:
The Oracle is a Ruin realm tile. Place a Unit on the Oracle to purchase one Adventure card or gain one Magic card.

Looking to add opportunity to do more Engine Building while playing Dwellings of Eldervale? The Oracle tile is your best option.

The Oracle Realm may extend game length since players will be able to gain Adventure cards and build their set of Tableau Actions without pulling a tile from the Realm Stack - one of the two "game clocks".

~~~ provided by the Publisher

431236.name: Dwellings of Eldervale: Legendary Upgrade Kit
431236.description:
Tales will be told of the day you acquired this legendary upgrade kit for Dwellings of Eldervale! Let's make some NOISE!!!

The Legendary Upgrade Kit includes 8 new Elemental Monsters and 9 Sound FX Bases. During game play players will now have a chose as to which Elemental Monster should appear when a Monster Lair tile is added to Eldervale.

Each Monster is 3 components: a 50mm Miniature, a standee (as an option to using the miniature), and a game card (details the Monster's unique abilities/game effects). The miniatures are made of colored plastic - the color of their Element - and have a black "wash" applied to highlight the sculpt details.

Elemental Monster Name and Element:
- Cloud Spirit (Air)
- Charging Earth (Earth)
- Volcanic Terror (Fire)
- The Kraken (Water)
- Golden Gryphon (Light)
- Haunting Phantom (Darkness)
- Bringer of Justice (Order)
- Arcane Thrasher (Chaos)

Each sound FX base is loaded with 2 Monster sounds so may be used with either the Deluxe or Legendary Monster miniature.

The 9th sound FX base is for the Frost Giant and Mother of Dragons optional play mini expansions included in the base game set of components.

ALL these components FIT INSIDE the Standard base game box.

~~~ Provided by Breaking Games

431929.name: Onward
431929.description:
Onward is the spiritual successor to Skytear, the competitive card-driven game inspired by MOBA video games such as League of Legends or DOTA2.

Players split into two teams, with each player controlling two or more champions.

The goal of the game is to destroy the enemy nexus that is a portal in the enemy base.

The game takes 45 to 90 minutes depending on the map that can have two or three lanes.

Lanes are corridors connecting the two nexuses and are populated with towers and minions from both teams.

Towers are defense structures preventing enemy champions and minions from rushing into the nexus.

Minions are weak units that grow in strength as they increase in number. They always try to advance toward the enemy nexus and attack any enemy in their way.

Jungles are dangerous areas between lanes where champions can venture to defeat monsters to gain gold and buy powerful items.

The river is a central area where your champions can go fight the colossal outsider... or die trying!

—description from the publisher

432527.name: Ethnos: 2nd Edition
432527.description:
In the faraway land of Ethnos, a new Age is dawning. The ashes of the old Age have left the Six Regions empty, and the twelve Clans scattered to the winds. Now is the time for a clever leader to unite them into a powerful alliance, skillfully using the unique talents of each Clan to control the Regions.
Do you have the wit and the wisdom to become the next Emperor of Ethnos and usher in a Golden Age?

Unite the Clans to Control Ethnos

What was old has been made new again. The land of Ethnos has been rendered empty and a new Age is beginning. Someone must take up the mantle of Emperor. Will it be you?

In Ethnos 2nd Edition, players must take control of the various clans of Ethnos, gathering members and unleashing them into the six regions. Each clan has different special abilities, and depending on who you choose to lead your groups, different strategies can be employed. 2nd Edition includes updated rules and rules for Solo mode.


     STRATEGIC AREA CONTROL GAME — In Ethnos 2nd Edition, players gather members of various clans and compete for control of six regions, utilizing each clan’s unique abilities to dominate the land.



     UNIQUE CLAN ABILITIES — Each clan in Ethnos offers distinct powers, adding deep strategy and diverse playstyles as you choose which clan leaders will guide your groups to victory.



     COMPETITIVE OR SOLO PLAY — Whether you’re challenging friends or conquering regions solo, Ethnos 2nd Edition provides endless strategic opportunities for players of all experience levels.



     FOR 1-6 PLAYERS — Perfect for game nights or solo sessions, Ethnos 2nd Edition is designed for 1-6 players, offering dynamic and exciting gameplay for ages 14 and up.



     UPDATED RULES & SOLO MODE — The 2nd Edition features updated rules for streamlined gameplay and introduces a new solo mode, allowing players to enjoy the game on their own.

432586.name: Thunder Road: Vendetta  – Turbo Tina's Swag Pack
432586.description:
Turbo Tina can see that you all came to party hearty! She's digging the success of this year's Carnival so much she put a special swag pack together as thanks.

Turbo Tina's Swag Pack collects the bonus components (stretch goals) for the Carnival of Chaos expansion. It was given to backers as a reward in the latter's campaign and is available for purchase by the retail buyers.

Notably, the pack includes additional sleeves for Carnival of Chaos and all the cards in the pack, in the same style as the Thunder Road: Vendetta – Sleeves.

expansions.name: Thunder Road: Vendetta – Carnival of Chaos

432589.name: Fateforge: Chronicles of Kaan – Kin of the Wild
432589.description:
Embark on an unforgettable adventure in Kin of the Wild, where the frozen lands of Northern Kaan await. This expansion introduces Pets—animal companions that fight, explore, and grow with you. These creatures aren’t just tagalongs—they’re mini-characters with their own unique Pet boards, abilities, action dice, and beautifully detailed miniatures.

Your journey takes you to the snow-swept harbor city of Katafygia. The shaman of a forest clan has been kidnapped, and the Kartaçöl Empire’s presence in the region is growing stronger by the day. Fearing an invasion of their forest homeland, the council has sent you to investigate. But you won’t be facing these dangers alone. Your loyal animal companions will be at your side, offering both strength and wisdom as you uncover the dark forces at work in the North.

Along with the introduction of Pets, this expansion brings even more depth to your adventures with two new factions, each more unpredictable and deadly than before, with new leader ability decks to keep you on your toes. Explore fresh terrain with two new floorplan sets—forest and wooden interiors—along with additional story scene tiles to keep the narrative fresh and dynamic. You’ll also discover new rest locations, weapons, and items to aid in your journey.

Whether you’re a fan of deep strategy, rich narrative, or tactical combat, Kin of the Wild offers an exciting new chapter filled with new mechanics and immersive storytelling.

—description from the publisher

families.name: Versions & Editions: Board Game Versions of Role-Playing Games

432693.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. The Board Game: Personal Stories
432693.description:
Personal Stories delves deeper into the Stalkers' stories, offering diverse tasks that reveal their motivations, haunted pasts, and personal desires. While not necessary to enjoy the main story campaign or Zone survival mode, it enriches the background narratives of the available characters, providing additional depth and insight.

—description from the publisher

432730.name: Endeavor: Deep Sea – Orca Reintroduction, Underwave Academy, and Robot Wanderer Mini Expansion
432730.description:
Orca Reintroduction: You have teamed up with a faclity that rehabilitates injured and displaced Orcas, preparing them to be returned to the wild. With your help, these majestic creatures can return to their ocean home and thrive!

Underwave Academy: The Underwave Academy isa next-generation training facility specially built for your team to get the underwater field experience and learn valuable new skills.

Robot Wanderer: New technology at your fingertips. Join up with the Wanderer Dock to control the sophisticated upgradeable Wanderer!

compilations.name: Endeavor: Deep Sea – Deluxe Upgrade Pack

433640.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches
433640.description:
Cthulhu: Death May Die returns with an all-new core box, Cthulhu: Death May Die - Forbidden Reaches!

In addition to new Investigators, Episodes, Elder Ones, and Monsters, Forbidden Reaches introduces Campaigns, a dynamic new mode that can be played with any Episode and any Elder One, unfolding across a three-act structure, creating a unique narrative experience with every playthrough.

expansions.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Atlach-Nacha Elder One Box
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Black Goat of the Woods
Cthulhu: Death May Die – CMON Comics: Vol. 1 Promos
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Dark Providence Investigators
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Exclusive Insanities
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Extra Campaigns
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Fear of the Unknown: Animal Allies
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches: Unimaginable Box
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Godzilla Rising
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Godzilla Vs Cthulhu
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Ithaqua the Wind-Walker
Cthulhu: Death May Die – R'lyehian Seizures Promo
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Robinson Crusoe Investigator
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Scarlett Hayes
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Season 4 Expansion

434227.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Atlach-Nacha Elder One Box
434227.description: This expansion introduces the terrifying new Elder One and its Hatchlings, which can be integrated into any Episode from any Season of Death May Die, adding fresh horrors and strategic depth to your gameplay.

expansions.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Fear of the Unknown
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches

434870.name: Shallow Regrets
434870.description:
Strange fish swim beneath your boat. Things with too many eyes, too many teeth. These eldritch anomalies are worth a small fortune, provided you’ve got a dauntless heart and an iron stomach.

Shallow Regrets is the leaner cousin of  Deep Regrets. Pull up unsettling curiosities in this strategic horror fishing game. Who knows what strange creatures lurk below the water's surface?

Each turn, the active player reels in 2 fish from the shoal(s) of their choice. They may choose one to keep in their boat. Unkept fish return to the shoals. Each fish has a strength value: to keep it, the player must have a number of hooks in their previously caught fish to meet the strength value. Most fish have otherworldly abilities that impact play. These can be used by exhausting the fish, turning it sideways to show that its ability has been used.

When all the fish have been caught all players tally up the total value of their caught fish. Some fish are considered foul, and whoever caught the most foul fish takes a scoring penalty for their poor efforts. The fisher with the highest total wins the game!

families.name: Players: Games with expansions that add solo play
Series: Wallet & Box Micro Games (Button Shy)
Versions & Editions: Travel Versions of Non-Travel Games

expansions.name: Shallow Regrets: The Fisher & the Frod

434938.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Season 6
434938.description:
