“But some of us awake in the night with strange phantasms of enchanted hills and gardens, of fountains that sing in the sun, of golden cliffs overhanging murmuring seas, of plains that stretch down to sleeping cities of bronze and stone, and of shadowy companies of heroes that ride caparisoned white horses along the edges of thick forests; and then we know that we have looked back through the ivory gates into that world of wonder which was ours before we were wise and unhappy.”

- H.P. Lovecraft

Season 6 is a full-fledged expansion for Cthulhu: Death May Die. Exploring the wondrous locations of Lovecraft’s Dream Cycle, this expansion brings brand-new game mechanics to Death May Die, including an 8-sided Dream Die and a set of ever-changing tiles, plus new Investigators, Monsters, Relics, nightmare-inducing (or maybe nightmare-induced!) Insanities, 6 new Episodes, and 1 new Elder One. No reason to pinch yourself, as this expansion is practically a dream come true… let’s just hope Investigators can survive it!

—description from the publisher

expansions.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Fear of the Unknown
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches

434955.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Exclusive Insanities
434955.description: A set of 4 Crowdfunding Exclusive Insanities: Metamorphosis, Haunting Apparition, Leeches, and Bone Spikes.

expansions.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Fear of the Unknown
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches

435008.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. The Board Game: Monster Hunter
435008.description:
Many regard the Monster Hunter with disbelief, thinking that he is just one more legend of the Zone, one of those lone wolves that do not serve anyone and do not bow to anyone. Some say that he took care of all the monsters that appeared when the Brain Scorcher was turned off. Others say he has superhuman abilities and that he can take down some of the most dangerous mutants with his hands down. Those who have seen him in action - or at least claim they have - swear that he is a force to be reckoned with. Surprisingly, there are few who say they have actually talked to him, and fewer still have heard any answer.

It is kinda weird to figure out that he is real and standing right next to you, isn't it?

This expansion adds a new character to the game.

435358.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Extra Campaigns
435358.description:
Campaign Decks are one of the unique features of Forbidden Reaches. These sets of cards add new depth and plotlines to your gameplay, allowing you to connect any 3 Episodes and transform it into a battle with higher stakes against an Elder One that gets ever stronger.

That is, of course, not enough for Investigators desiring more stories to tell, so the Extra Campaigns Expansion features 3 new Campaign Decks, diving deep into the mythos lore and telling different stories: The Rescue, The Hidden Enemy, and Keeper of Reality.

expansions.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Fear of the Unknown
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches

435994.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. The Board Game: Stretch Goals Box
435994.description:
The Stretch Goals Box contains all the rewards that were unlocked as part of the Gamefunding campaign on Gamefound.

The Stretch Goal Box, for example, adds several new playable missions, new weapons and artifacts, additional Stalker miniatures, plastic markers, new monsters with their miniatures and related equipment, Maps & Stickers Recharge Pack, Magnet Artifact Die which allows you to customize your anomaly exploration by rolling the die for specific effects, opening new possibilities and increasing your chances of extracting valuable artifacts from the depths of the Zone, and much more!

435997.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. The Board Game: Duty & Freedom Faction Pack
435997.description:
Introducing the Duty & Freedom Faction Pack, a comprehensive expansion that brings new elements and strategic options to your gameplay. This add-on will allow you to align your goals with one of the factions: Freedom or Duty.

This pack includes 4 detailed Duty miniatures and 4 versatile Freedom models, allowing you to immerse yourself in the conflict between these factions. They will be designed with visible Faction patches and produced in two different colors to make them more immersive and easier to distinguish!

Among other components you will also find a dedicated Campaign Book, offering a rich narrative experience as this add-on comes with THREE new missions that you can play outside or between the core campaign.

The Duty & Freedom Faction Pack will also expand your tactical options known from the core game by introducing 8 new Enemy cards! With 3 sets of 25 Enviro cards per mission, you'll face a variety of environmental conditions that add depth and unpredictability to your encounters.
With Factions being in a permanent conflict against each other you will be also able to take advantage of 18 new Weapon cards and provide your allies with enhanced protection using 24 unique Armor cards.

435998.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. The Board Game: Zone Companions
435998.description: With this pack, you'll receive 3 new companions miniatures, along with a rules reference card and a dedicated token, allowing you to venture into the Zone with different companions by your side.

436059.name: Nucleum: Energy Research Institute
436059.description:
As the Twentieth Century dawns, the world is forever changed. Fueled by the Uranium Revolution, a new era of prosperity is here. The rich, the powerful, the free spirited... They all want a slice of the new life. Lucky for them, the energy consortiums working all over the planet, from Saxony to Australia, are more than happy to sell a few shares for extra investments. With these seemingly inexhaustible new sources of funding more and more entrepreneurs dared to set up their own experiment, and set out to make their own glowing bright green path to success! But no one can reach their heights with ambition only. Powerful Patrons are here, offering their wealth and knowledge to help you reach a new level and become the most respected entrepreneur of the time!

Nucleum: Energy Research Institute is an expansion to the base game of Nucleum and brings to life 8 new Experiments, and Patron cards with powerful abilities. All new Experiments are also compatible with Nucleum: Australia, Nucleum: Court of Progress, and Nucleum: Patrons Set.

—description from the publisher

436126.name: Finspan
436126.description:
You are a marine researcher seeking to find and observe an array of aquatic life in the colorful Sunlight Zone, ghostly Twilight Zone, and pitch-black Midnight Zone of the world's seas and oceans. In Finspan, the fish you discover over four weeks will generate a series of benefits as you dive deeper into the ocean.

Each dive site specializes in a key aspect of expanding your research:


     Grow your collection of fish.
     Discover freshly laid eggs.
     Hatch eggs into young and consolidate young to form schools.


The winner is the player with the most points gained from fish, eggs, young, schools, and achievements.

—description from the publisher

436205.name: Rewild: South America
436205.description:
Rewild: South America is a unique, medium-weight, card-driven, engine-building board game for nature enthusiasts with a heart for wildlife that can be enjoyed in 45-60 minutes.

The thematic focus of Rewild is on the fauna and flora of the South American ecoregions Caatinga, Gran Chaco, Cerrado, Pantanal, Amazon rainforest and Atlantic rainforest. These 6 ecoregions and all their inhabitants exhibit diverse interrelationships and dependencies. One of the core concerns of game author Bruno Liguori Sia, who lives in Brazil himself, was to depict and convey this complex network in a game.

In terms of game mechanics, Rewild has a straightforward foundation. On their turn, each player plays a card and chooses one of two depicted actions. After carrying out this action, the player can attract animals and plants on display to their ecosystem. As soon as a player has 8 (or 9) face-up animal cards in front of them, the end of the game is triggered.

However, you shouldn't be fooled by this essentially simple basis, as every game of Rewild features countless decisions and plays differently every time due to the enormous variety of cards. Questions that players are faced with include: 

    How do I generate enough resources (water, minerals, seeds) to expand my ecosystem? Where do I place which biomes so that their effects optimally promote the expansion of my ecosystem? Do I focus on one biome or several? Would it make sense to upgrade my existing biomes? 
    When do I get all my action cards back into my hand to have more options and resources available again?  Do I do this once, twice or even three times and what are my opponents planning? Will I still have enough time to play all my cards in time for them to count towards the effects of my animal cards? 
    Which animal and plant cards do I bring into my ecosystem to create an optimally linked ecosystem that generates as many victory points as possible? Are there any cards with immediate effects that would be interesting for a retrigger? Do I keep an animal species until the end, or do I immediately generate points by making it the target of a predator?


The player who best answers and masters all these questions in a game of Rewild receives the most victory points and wins the game.

—description from the publisher

436217.name: The Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship
436217.description:
As members of The Fellowship and the allies who rise to aid them, you must embark on a journey that may either save or doom Middle-earth. Navigate a world beset by shadow, where every choice forges a new path. The threads of destiny weave together, and the fate of The Free Peoples lies in your valor, friendship, and resolve. Will the One Ring be cast into the fire, or will the bearer be lost to despair?

The Lord of the Rings: Fate of the Fellowship is a co-operative game in which each player controls two characters, lending their unique abilities to protect Frodo, battle enemies in pivotal locations, and evade the menacing Nazgûl and Sauron's searching Eye.

Each playthrough presents new challenges with 24 different objectives, 14 events, and 13 playable characters. The game is won if the group destroys the One Ring before Frodo loses all hope.

A solo adventure is included.

—description from the publisher

families.name: Components: Dice Cup / Dice Tower / Dice Tray
Versions & Editions: Versions with IP after the original release

436651.name: The Vale of Eternity: Curse
436651.description:
In the vale, an ancient evil stirs. It has slumbered for years and years and now, it has taken root in every living being, whatever their magical ability. Can you resist the dreadful influence of the Curse-Tree, or will you seek its dark blessings?
This expansion consists of a main module with new cards to shuffle into the card deck, and Tamer tiles. It can also be used with the other expansion for Vale of Eternity, Artifacts.

Contents:
28 cards

8 Summoner tiles

1 Tree standee

12 double sided Ward tokens

40 Curse tokens

—description from the publisher

436821.name: Everdell Silverfrost
436821.description:
Silverfrost is the next standalone edge of the map series of Everdell.  Beyond the snow-capped Spirecrest mountains to the south of Everdell Valley, lies the bold country of Silverfrost. It is your task to build and maintain a city in this challenging landscape. You must clear the piling snow, burn the fires to keep your citizens warm and prosperous, and complete important quests for the Ranger’s Guild.

In Silverfrost, you send critter workers to various Locations on the board, cards, or the mountain to gather resources and activate unique effects. You use these resources to play cards face up in front of you, forming your own city. Each turn, you take 1 of 3 possible actions — Place a worker, Play a card, or Prepare for the next season. You may place 1 of your workers on any Basic Location, Red Destination card in your city or opponent’s cities, the Forge, the Hot Springs, or a mountaintop Beacon, so long as it is not blocked by Snow or another worker. You then claim the  listed resources or perform the action. If there is Snow at the location, you must first spend a Fire resource to clear the snow pile. If you use your unique Ranger worker, you can visit an occupied location, or gain a Fire resource if visiting a location alone.

To play a card, you must pay the listed cost of resources. If it is a Critter, you may instead play it for free by using 1 of your 2 Chimneys, so long as you have the necessary Fire to light it. Cards may be played either from your hand, or from the area of face-up cards on the board known as the Valley. Nearly all of the cards in Silverfrost feature new and powerful abilities, offering a huge variety of strategic depth and combos to explore.

If all of your workers are deployed, you may prepare for the next season by bringing back all of your workers, gaining a new worker, and performing the action described for the following season, introducing new snowfall to the board and to your city, as well as other challenges. A player is finished when they have played through the last season (Spring) and cannot perform any more actions. After all players have finished, the player with the most points is the winner.

—description from the publisher

437940.name: SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence – Gateway to Mars Promo Card
437940.description:
Originally available as part of A Pack from the Dice Tower 2025 Gamefound campaign.

Name: Gateway to Mars
card#: SE EN 02

income corner: [credit]

[2 publicity] [5 points]

Flavor text: 
For man to reach Mars, we require the coordinated development of new propulsion systems, life support systems, radiation protection, and other key technologies.

438182.name: Leaf: Deluxe Edition
438182.description:
Strategic tile laying with uniquely shaped leaves and set collection of forest animals
Upgraded FSC certified wooden leaf tiles and tokens
A deluxe box with a full piece of art for the box back
INCLUDES SEASON OF THE BEAR EXPANSION

families.name: Versions & Editions: Big Box Versions of Individual Games

compilations.name: Leaf
Leaf: Season of the Bear Expansion

438231.name: Forest Shuffle: Exploration
438231.description:
Good things come in threes! The third expansion deck for Forest Shuffle offers three sets of cards to add to the base game:

First, there is an official Automa deck of 20 cards with 12 challenges to complete.

Next, a set of five brand new caves with individual powers to replace the regular caves of the base game.

Last but not least, this deck contains a selection of 15 special playing cards featuring selected and rare species from around the world. These cards have been available as promo cards in 2024.

With 55 cards in total, this set complements the flora and fauna of Forest Shuffle base game and offers endless possibilities for exploration and adventure.

Manufactured from FSC-certified material.

—description from the publisher

Contains Promo cards: 
P001-Moor Birch
P002-Whinchat/Fire Salamander
P004-Palm Tree
P005-Gnat/Red Panda
P006-Robin/Water Vole
P007-Bison/White Stork
P008-Cardinal/Say's Firefly
P009-Genet/European Badger
P010-Cuckoo/Chanterelle

438936.name: The White Castle Duel
438936.description:
Following the arrival of the Portuguese in Japan, daimyos competed for control of foreign trade and technology. Himeji Castle, a symbol of feudal power, became a strategic center for clans seeking to gain influence.

In The White Castle Duel, two clans compete to exert their influence in the White Heron's court, managing resources and building engines. On each turn, you will use their lamp tokens to obtain resources and activate actions. Among the actions available, you can buy and upgrade influence cards, place clan seals on gardens and training grounds, move your courtier between circles of influence, or trade with the Portuguese. These actions will allow you to accumulate a series of icons — flags, katanas, kabutos, and origami figures — that will reward you with points, and whoever ends up with the most points wins.

—description from the publisher

families.name: Versions & Editions: Two-Player Versions of More-Player Games

439306.name: Limit
439306.description:
Limit is a competitive strategy game where you play as a Nation facing the challenges of our world. Make crucial political decisions, manage your resources with finesse, anticipate global crises and adapt to the upheavals of the planet and the decisions of other Nations. Balance growth and resilience to build a prosperous society.

The game takes place in a maximum of 7 generations. However, the end of the game can come before if you and your opponents trigger at least 4 global crises.

A generation is made up of 3 phases:


     The Political phase: you make decisions
     The Social phase: your Nation reacts to these decisions
     The International phase: crises arise and alliances are formed


End of the Game:
Before counting your points, you must test the resilience of your Nation for future generations. Redo the Food, Consumption and Production stages of the Social phase with the effects of shortages but without new crises.

The Nation with the highest score wins the game.

439816.name: Lost Ruins of Arnak: Twisted Paths
439816.description:
Twisted Paths is the final major addition to the world of Arnak. Its highlight is a new double-sided map, bigger than the one in the base game, that features two new research tracks, each with unique mechanisms and components.

On the map, you can choose to explore its daytime side and scale the white stone of the Owl Temple. It uses unique new temple tiles that, if combined together, can become extra idol slots, and a third research token, a lantern, that brings even stronger research rewards. You can also brave the night and journey through the dark caverns of the Spider Temple. This side uses a new resource, dark tablets, used to invoke mysterious altars and place artifacts directly onto the research track to be used when ascending the track. But beware—using the dark tablets can give you strong rewards, but also cost you points should you become too ambitious!

In addition to the two new maps, the expansion also contains new guardians, sites, and assistants. It also brings some solo content—Rival tiles for the new maps, as well as Purple Rival tiles and Rival Objectives, two mini expansions we’ve previously released online as print-and-play.

Lost Ruins of Arnak: Twisted Paths was previously included in the Adventure Chest, a limited-edition storage box with an original insert designed by CGE.

—description from the publisher

families.name: Versions & Editions: Big Box Versions of Individual Games

compilations.name: Lost Ruins of Arnak: Solo Mini Expansions

440640.name: Even Deeper Regrets
440640.description:
Gameplay in Even Deeper Regrets is the same as in the base game with one major exception: you can now choose to start each day Inland in addition to Sea and Port! Inland, you can fish from three River shoals or one Loch shoal, both of which have a higher risk/reward ratio than the Sea. 74 new fish and 25 dinks await inland!

You can also fish an entirely new sea of fish, with 117 brand-spanking new fish to discover. Mix them together with the base game fish or play with just the expansion fish, it's up to you!

New polyps introduce a new mechanic: every polyp is worth more for each other polyp in play.

New items and equipment are available including a new supply type: pets! Pets sit faithfully by your side and offer a persistent benefit - but they can still be lost at sea, so try not to get attached.

—description from the designer

441079.name: Agemonia: New Little Things
441079.description: This expansion contains new Event Cards, New Ally and Henchmen cards, a new Profession (Aoxcraft), new Item cards, and several new tokens to enhance your gaming experience.

441082.name: Agemonia: New Heroes
441082.description:
This expansion contains two new Heroes: Garuk, a cursed boryot shapechanger and crymacner, and Xir, a lone xi-noq Soulblade or Sorcerer that has lost two of its triad.

Note: The 3 hero miniatures are already included in the base game box.

441696.name: Sanctuary
441696.description:
In Sanctuary, you will plan and design a modern, scientifically-managed zoo for animals and visitors. A supply of 135 unique zoo tiles provides you with animals, buildings, and projects. In every game, you want to find the best mix from those available to build the most successful zoological establishment. Different effects on the tiles will help you to achieve conservation goals and to increase the attraction of your zoo.

Each player has a set of four action cards to manage their gameplay, and the power of an action is determined by the slot the card currently occupies. One of those cards will let you play projects, and the other three cards will let you play animals of a specific habitat: forest, rock, or water.

Sanctuary is based on its predecessor Ark Nova, but modifies and simplifies many of the mechanisms of that game in an elegant and surprising manner. Your goal to find the best way to puzzle together your animals, buildings, and projects on your zoo map is an ongoing pleasure!

—description from the publisher

442296.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches: Unimaginable Box
442296.description:
A box containing all Stretch Goal promos!

The Unimaginable Box contains all the crowdfunding exclusive stretch goals for Cthulhu: Death May Die - Forbidden Reaches:


     23 investigators
     7 Monsters with Unknown Monster cards
     4 Lost Episodes with Monsters and Monster cards
     Elder Ones Cthugha and Xylarthoth
     5 Relics
     1 Insanity
     Extra tiles


Gamefound campaign for Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches

expansions.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches

443196.name: Dead by Daylight: The Board Game – Lightbringer Expansion
443196.description:
Enhance your Dead By Daylight: The Board Game experience with this expansion!
 Play as one of the new Survivors and utilize their unique perks to escape from a new cabal of terrifying Killers with horrifying abilities you've never seen before!

Each turn, players will plan their moves by secretly selecting paths on the board to move along. Each time a player moves, they will reveal new features of the board, called props, which they can interact with to further their objectives or to hinder their opponents.

Survivors are able to utilize many different props to aid in their survival and navigation of the trial. Killers can make use of fewer props—instead, they interact with the Survivors using their attack or their unique power. Each Killer has a different power that will completely change the way the game plays.

Both Killers and Survivors have perks which grant them special abilities. Experienced players can customize their characters with various perk configurations, offering even more replayability.

The Lightbringer Expansion introduces an additional 3 Killers and 4 Survivors:
6 new Killer miniatures: x4 The Unknown, The Singularity, The Skull Merchant
Four new Survivors: Thalita, Renato, Gabriel, Sable
New Perks for these characters.

—description from the publisher

expansions.name: Dead by Daylight: The Board Game
Dead by Daylight: The Board Game – Collector's Edition

444192.name: Inferno: Plutus & Phlegyas
444192.description:
This expansion adds two more Guardians to the core game, plus Dante himself. It includes 3 miniatures, 2 large cards and new cardboard components: 9 Bells and 8 Desks. It Includes a QR with the rules in 11 languages.

Plutus: Form an alliance with the god of wealth, and he will allow you to set up customs offices in Hell to charge passage fees to your rivals.
Place one of your two Desks below any shield. Every time a player passes through, they must pay you one drachma.

Phlegyas: Summon him by ringing a Bell. Phlegyas the ferryman will navigate out of the muddy waters of the River Styx and come to your aid.
Ring one of your Bells and place Phlegyas on a circle. Before playing your Hell phase, you may move the soul laterally to any empty shield in that circle before making it descend to a lower level.

Dante: Replace the wooden meeple with this miniature.

(Both these guardians were part of the Deluxe Edition of inferno.)

—description from the publisher

compilations.name: Inferno: Collector’s Edition

445048.name: SETI: Space Agencies
445048.description:
SETI: Space Agencies, an expansion for SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence, introduces powerful asymmetric organizations — each with unique abilities, strategic advantages, and starting conditions that redefine how you approach the search for alien life.

As the leader of one of these institutions — ranging from private tech companies to global research networks — you'll bring a distinct perspective and specialized tools to the mission, unlocking bold new strategies and rewarding long-term planning.

In addition to these organizations, the expansion adds three new alien species, each with their own unique twists, and over forty new project cards inspired by real-world initiatives. These integrate seamlessly into the main deck, providing even greater variety and strategic options.

"Quick Start" cards, designed for use with the organizations, let you skip the slower opening round and dive straight into the action. They introduce an extra layer of asymmetry during set-up and can be used to further accelerate games in lower player counts.

Finally, the expansion introduces signal tokens, a subtle but meaningful new mechanism that enhances scanning efficiency.

Whether you're adapting to your organization's strengths or navigating fresh interstellar challenges, SETI: Space Agencies deepens the strategic landscape of your mission to discover life beyond Earth.

expansions.name: SETI: Space Agencies – Space Agencies Promo Card

445166.name: The Elder Scrolls: Betrayal of the Second Era – Cheeses of Tamriel
445166.description:
Do you like cheese? Do you like ...erm ...lots of cheese? Does that affinity for dairy delights extend to your Betrayal of the Second Era character? Well, we've got that character covered! You can't eat these cheeses, but your fictional characters can. And you can imagine The smile on their faces as they enjoy wheel after wheel! *

The Cheeses of Tamriel offers 20 unique cheeses direct from the world of The Elder Scrolls online! 19 offer unique name and art with an identical effect, while the single, legendary (legendairy?) Shivering Cheese offers just a hair more benefit! Careful though, overconsumption of The Cheeses of Tamriel will leave your character healthy, but very clogged up...with fatigue. What did you think we meant?


     Dairy not approved for Argonian consumption.


—description from the designer

families.name: Game: The Elder Scrolls Betrayal of the Second Era
Video Game Theme: The Elder Scrolls

expansions.name: The Elder Scrolls: Betrayal of the Second Era

446319.name: Quietbell
446319.description:
Quietbell is an adventure detective game inspired by the works of Howard Phillips Lovecraft.

You’ll experience an engaging interactive story whose outcome depends entirely on you and your choices. Throughout the game, you will piece together a larger picture and unravel the tangled fates and events that took place in the mysterious town of Quietbell.

The game features a "nonlinear communication" mechanic, allowing the player to interact with various in-game characters on different topics at their discretion.

The game also features a "strokes" mechanic using transparent plastic cards, allowing the player to create their own unique picture.

—description from the designer

446493.name: Recall
446493.description:
Recall is a deep strategy game from the designers of Revive that focuses on engine building and exploration. Each player begins the game with one of fourteen unique tribes and one of eighteen unique gadgets, both of which will heavily influence your strategy and opportunities. Throughout the game, you will lead your tribe, explore the lands, and discover traces of ancient civilizations to learn from them. On your turn, you either:

• Use a keycard to activate an action box, or
• Recall to produce resources and regain your keycards.

When you use a keycard, you activate the abilities of the keycard itself and the effects of the chosen action box. The chosen combination of keycard and action box will therefore determine what you get to do on your turn: populate the lands, move your followers, explore new regions, and build workshops, vaults, or monuments. During the game, you will improve your tribe by acquiring new keycards, upgrading your action boxes, or collecting ability stones and relics.

An important part of the game is searching dig sites for traces of ancient civilizations. These sites unlock access to the abilities and gadgets of ancient tribes, in addition to providing important scoring opportunities.

Three times during the game, players must choose one of two paths, with the chosen path providing an immediate bonus, as well as boosting one of the endgame scoring categories.

By using the optional digital companion website, players can archive their tribes at the end of their game, thereby making their tribes discoverable as ancient civilizations in other players' games.

—description from the designer

447305.name: Inis: Legendary Edition
447305.description:
Inis is a game deeply rooted in Celtic history and lore in which players win by being elected King of the Island (Inis).

Careful drafting, hand management, bluffing (especially once players understand the importance of passing their turn), good timing, and a precise understanding of the balance of power are the keys to victory. After a discovery game, you'll be ready for a full and epic game, where an undisputed player will be king by the Assembly for his merit and wisdom.

This new 3rd edition of Inis features all-new artwork, along with the Seasons of Inis and Nemed expansions.

families.name: Versions & Editions: Big Box Versions of Individual Games

compilations.name: Inis
Inis: Nemed
Inis: Seasons of Inis

447843.name: Netherworld Candle
447843.description:
The veil between worlds is thin, and shadows stir in the forgotten tombs of emperors. You are an "Earth Sapper", a master of forbidden arts, venturing into darkness where others fear to tread. Welcome to Netherworld Candle, a cooperative campaign adventure. Together, you will delve into perilous ancient tombs, unearth long-lost secrets, and confront ancient evils that threaten to consume the world. Navigate treacherous environments, solve intricate puzzles, and battle terrifying supernatural entities as you uncover a thrilling narrative where your decisions have real consequences. Will you embrace your destiny, or succumb to the darkness?

Netherworld Candle is a cooperative adventure game set against the tumultuous backdrop of early 19th-century China, where ancient myths are violently unleashed amidst the clash of empires. The experience spans a core game, four full expansions, and a massive stretch goal box packed with content. The game's background is based on real historical events. You will be in the eastern continent in the late 19th century, amidst the chaos of the fall of the Qing Empire and revolutionary uprisings, seeking the meaning of your existence.

—description from the publisher

448054.name: Arkham Horror: The Card Game – Film Fatale: Scenario Pack
448054.description:
Lights, camera, action!

It’s the golden age of silent filmmaking, with instant classics popping up on the silver screen left and right. But when an ambitious new producer unwittingly releases accursed horrors upon three different film sets, it’s up to our intrepid investigators to fix things before the credits roll on the entire production!

In Film Fatale, one to four investigators ham it up in Hollywood’s Lot C, where three troubled film sets are host to several bizarre and dangerous events. As spacetime warps and fiction becomes reality, you’ll find yourselves negotiating with alien Saturnites, fleeing from hungry dinosaurs, and warding off bloodthirsty vampires as you try to wrap up this thrilling mystery. The scenario can be played on its own or inserted into any campaign as a side-story.

—description from the publisher

families.name: Game: Arkham Horror – The Card Game
Series: Arkham Horror Files (Fantasy Flight Games)

expansions.name: Arkham Horror: The Card Game (Revised Core Set)

450040.name: Card Bullet Re:Load
450040.description: Be the last person standing in this simple card game which simulates the play experience of a free-for-all first person shooter. Play cards to shoot at your opponents. However beware they may have counter cards which deflect damage back to you. It's everyone for themselves. On your turn you can only choose to play a card or reload (draw a card). Don't get tied up fighting one opponent and wasting away all your cards. When you are down with few cards, that's when the other players will pounce on you.

450043.name: Olenon
450043.description:
Olenon is a 4-player partnership game and a climbing game. To win a round, either you or your partner must play all your cards. Combos in the game are singles, pairs, trios and olenon (four of a kind). You can beat a combo by playing the same combo but with higher cards, or you can add a card to the combo, claiming it for yourself. If you pass (whether voluntarily or otherwise), you must take one card from the current combo. Also you may not play any more cards this hand. A hand ends when both partners in a team pass, or when anyone plays an olenon.

Win 2 rounds to win the game.

450429.name: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-Earth – Allies
450429.description:
The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-Earth – Allies features various characters from J.R.R. Tolkien's universe who will come to the aid of either the Fellowship or Sauron.

Collect power tokens in each chapter and use them to call upon your allies and benefit from their effects.

expansions.name: The Lord of the Rings: Duel for Middle-earth

451166.name: 108 Outlaws
451166.description:
Relive one of Chinese history’s classic epics in 108 Outlaws! In this immersive and challenging tableau-building card game, put together a motley troop of reformed criminals with different abilities and effects, embark on game-changing missions and write your own history. With 108 unique bandits to choose from, every game will be an all-new adventure!

The rules are simple - on your turn, either play 1 card or use 2 draw points to take cards. Earth Outlaws will give you special bonus effects when played, while Heaven Outlaws will earn you precious honour points at the end of the game. At any time during your turn, exhaust your outlaws to go on missions to earn honour points and bonus actions.

When one player has 12 Outlaws, the player with the most honour points wins the game!

—description from the publisher

453310.name: SETI: Space Agencies – Space Agencies Promo Card
453310.description:
Available as a promo card when pre-ordering SETI - Space Agencies.

The card has a cost of two credits, and it allows the player to launch a probe and to take a signal token. In addition, it reads:

The next time you play SETI with quick start cards, gain one extra card to choose from at the start of the game.

453392.name: Terraforming Mars: The Dice Game – Missions
453392.description:
Return to the Red Planet and find new ways to terraform. This expansion introduces a new dice color representing influence, purple dice with special effects. With new corporations, new project cards, but especially a new mission mechanic that boosts player interaction, this expansion gives new life to an already loved game.

—description from the publisher

453406.name: Wyrmspan: Dragon Academy
453406.description:
As a budding dracologist, you open an academy for fledgling dragons to achieve their full potential! The expansion to Wyrmspan adds a wide variety of new dragons and caves, objective tiles, dragon guilds, and a new round tracker that presents you with an income choice when you pass for the round. Welcome to Wyrmspan: Dragon Academy, designed by Connie Vogelmann and illustrated by Clémentine Campardou!

—description from the publisher

453941.name: Zenith: Secret Agents
453941.description: Refresh your deck and your tactics with a compact add-on for Zenith. The Secret Agents booster introduces new Agent cards that plug straight into the base game, unlocking fresh lines of play and tighter decision space with minimal rules overhead. Designed for 2–4 players (ages 12+, ~25–35 min), it’s an easy way to diversify strategies and boost replayability between missions to the Senate.

454854.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Godzilla Rising
454854.description:
Godzilla Rising:

Godzilla Rising is a special Crowdfunding Exclusive expansion that brings a new level of excitement to the game. Featuring the giant Godzilla figure and 2 Epic episodes, this expansion introduces fresh mechanics and challenges that will test even the most experienced players.

Awakened from his slumber, the King of the Monsters' unpredictable fury and overwhelming destructive power can make him either an ally or a hindrance in the battle against the otherworldly forces, adding an extra layer of danger to Investigators, who must contend with Godzilla’s rampage. Regardless of who or what he targets, his mere presence could tip the balance against the cosmic forces.

Let’s first talk about the kaiju in the room: the megature. Standing over 54.5 cm tall (about 21.45 in) and with a base of 43.8x45.2 cm (around 17.24x17.79 in), Godzilla is an epic sculpt, to say the least. In addition to being a masterpiece, it features a sculpted base that plays a key role in gameplay. Investigators must navigate different areas around the base to achieve their goals, while designated zones allow artillery figures to be placed and used throughout 2 Epic episodes - each exploring the consequences of Godzilla's presence in very different ways.

Godzilla vs Cthulhu:

In the Godzilla VS Cthulhu Epic Episode, the investigators and Godzilla must join forces against a common enemy of eldritch nature… Or rather, the investigators must aid Godzilla in any way they can while trying to survive the titan battle at the same time.

The ritual succeeded, and cultists have managed to summon Cthulhu into our reality. Some will say Godzilla has risen as a protector of this world, while others believe it simply sensed a threat to its dominance over land and sea. Whatever the reason, what can mere humans do when facing two creatures of impossible might? Whatever their firepower can manage. Keep the cultists at bay and try to survive to see the end of the battle!

This Epic Episode was designed to have the two Death May Die megatures face off against each other, with exclusive tiles setting the stage for the showdown, where Investigators – tiny, pitiful humans - find themselves trapped between the two colossal forces. For this reason, the Crowdfunding Exclusive R'lyeh Rising expansion is required to play this Epic Episode.

expansions.name: Cthulhu: Death May Die – Fear of the Unknown
Cthulhu: Death May Die – Forbidden Reaches
Cthulhu: Death May Die – R'lyeh Rising

456891.name: SETI: Search for Extraterrestrial Intelligence – DLR Promo Card
456891.description:
Available as a promo card at Spiel Essen 2025.

The card has a cost of two credits, and it allows the player to launch a probe and to take a a resource depending on the colour of the sector you are in.

In addition it reads:
The German Aerospace Center (DLR) conducts earth observation missions and high altitude research using high-tech equipment such as the mobile rocket base MORABA.

457030.name: Orloj: Essen 2025 Promo
457030.description:
Promo given to limited buyers who purchased the game at Spiel 2025. Later given also to pre-orders via publishers' websites.

It consists out of a wooden pinnacle, that can be used as an alternative round marker or first player marker and 2 additional hammer cards.

One of them will give you the ability to expand your workshop (in combination with a free resource at level III) when building, the other will give you a free resource at level II and a free resource + the recovery of a worker at level III.

457860.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. The Board Game: Maps & Stickers Recharge Pack
457860.description: Provides extra sets of maps and stickers for three additional full playthroughs of the core box and stretch goal campaigns and add-ons.

458896.name: Al-Kahuf
458896.description:
Al-Kahuf is an adventure detective game inspired by the works of Howard Phillips Lovecraft.

You’ll experience an engaging interactive story whose outcome depends entirely on you and your choices. You are about to set out in the footsteps of a missing expedition that had been exploring the area near the town of Al-Kahuf before vanishing in the scorching sands of Egypt. Talk to characters, explore locations, carry out excavations. The outcome of the story will depend on your actions, choices, and deductions.

The game features a "nonlinear communication" mechanic, allowing the player to interact with various in-game characters on different topics at their discretion.

—description from the designer

463126.name: Arkham Horror: The Card Game
463126.description:
Introducing the newest core set for Arkham Horror: The Card Game! Take the role of a unique investigator and explore the world of Arkham. Build a customized deck that represents your investigators abilities, supplies, actions, and skills. Customize your deck as you progress through narratively driven scenarios and uncover the horrors that lie just below the surface of this 1920s alternate world. Explore stories which evolve with your choices, successes, and failures to tell a unique story either solo or with up to three of your friends.

Serving simultaneously as both a continuation and a fresh starting point, this new core set heralds the beginning of Chapter Two for the game. Taking place several months after the city of Arkham suffered a devastating calamity, this box provides a new introductory campaign, five mechanically-new investigators, and a fresh card pool to expand your collection—or start a new one!
Whether you’re an Arkham Horror veteran or a newcomer looking to get into the game, you won’t want to miss out on this new core set. This core set will replace the Revised Core Set from 2021 and become the new evergreen core experience for the game going forward. That said, all player content in this box is fully compatible with all previously-released Arkham Horror: The Card Game products—it is still the same game, after all!

—description from the publisher

Series: Arkham Horror Files (Fantasy Flight Games)

469951.name: The Bad Karmas and The Curse of the Zodiac: Volume 2
469951.description:
Volume 2 is the first major gameplay expansion for The Bad Karmas and the Curse of the Zodiac. It continues the epic saga of the heroes’ struggle against the awakened demigods, introducing four new Zodiacs, each with unique abilities and increasingly complex strategies, that will challenge even the most seasoned groups.
As in the base game, each battle in Volume 2 is made even more immersive thanks to integration with the Teburu system, which automatically handles rules, effects, and story developments. This allows players to focus on tactics, cooperation, and narrative choices without slowing down the flow of the game.

New Zodiacs
Volume 2 includes 4 high-quality "Smart Miniatures" representing the next set of Zodiac signs. Each boss features unique attack patterns and environmental interactions:

     Leo: A fierce combatant focusing on raw power and intimidation.
     Virgo: Likely focused on precision, debuffs, or complex tactical puzzles.
     Libra: Features mechanics revolving around balance and punishing players' positioning.
     Scorpio: Specialized in stealth, poison, or sudden lethal strikes.


New Scenarios & Environments
4 new Tactical Maps, as each Zodiac comes with its own dedicated physical board map (2 double-sided maps in total) and specific environment standees (26 items in total).

Narrative Campaign Expansion
New story chapters that advance the "Curse of the Zodiac" plotline, fully narrated and handled by the companion app."

—description from the publisher

expansions.name: The Bad Karmas and The Curse of the Zodiac

469954.name: The Bad Karmas and The Curse of the Zodiac: Volume 3
469954.description:
Volume 3 is the climactic finale to the 'Curse of the Zodiac' saga. This expansion introduces the final four Zodiacs demigods, completing the astrological circle and offering the most challenging encounters in the series thanks to their unpredicatable behaviors, with dynamic mid-fight transformations that significantly shift the gameplay loop.
As with other expansions, Volume 3 takes full advantage of the Teburu digital system, which handles rules, events, and campaign progression, leaving players free to focus on tactical and interpretive choices.

New Zodiacs
Volume 3 completes the roster of the Zodiacs with 4 high-quality Smart Miniatures representing the four final zodiac signs, known for having the most unpredictable attack patterns and reactions:
- Sagittarius: A master of range and mobility, forcing players to manage distance constantly.
- Capricorn: A defensive powerhouse that utilizes environmental obstacles and ""shattering"" mechanics.
- Aquarius: Focuses on area-of-control and elemental manipulation (water/ice effects).
- Pisces: Features deceptive mechanics, often splitting the players' focus.

New Scenarios & Environments
4 unique Tactical Maps, with high-detail boards that feature specific terrain types (cliffs, ritual sites, etc.) and dedicated environment standees (18 items in total).

The Grand Finale Campaign
The app-driven story reaches its conclusion, with the final narrative arc revealing the ultimate truth behind the "Bad Karmas" and the curse itself.

—description from the publisher

471115.name: The Bad Karmas and the Curse of Cthulhu: Volume 5
471115.description:
The Bad Karmas and The Curse of Cthulhu is the new installment in The Bad Karmas series. Once again the fate of humanity is at stake but this time the fight is against Cthulhu and many other Great Old Ones.

In this fifth, standalone volume our unlikely heroes find themselves in the 1920s, a world where obscure cults and cosmic horrors are spreading, and ancient, otherworldly powers are awakening. This time, The Bad Karmas have to keep their sanity and avoid falling into madness. As the madness rises, heroes can unlock special "last resort" actions that could help during the fight, but by reaching their madness limit they will suffer major setbacks for the remainder of the battle.

The Bad Karmas and The Curse of Cthulhu is a cooperative tactical boss-battle board game, made even more immersive thanks to integration with the Teburu system, which automatically handles rules, effects, and story developments. This allows players to focus on tactics, cooperation, and narrative choices without slowing down the flow of the game.
Work together to defeat the Great Old Ones who evolve and respond in real-time to player actions, and live a one-of-a-kind, immersive gaming experience.

Volume 5 box includes:

     3 unique Great Old Ones (Nyarlathotep, Shub-Niggurath, Ghatanothoa)
     4 new Forgotten Heroes (the Bucher, the Nun, the Sailor, the Geisha)
     2 double-sided board maps
     environmental elements standees


—description from the designer
